job.title: Sr. Delivery Solutions Architect (Greater China Region)
job.description_text:
CSQ427R262
At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilizing the the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a Sr. Delivery Solutions Architect (Sr. DSA), you will play an important role during this journey. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform in your customers. You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability to our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage on Databricks workloads that they have already selected, helping them maximise the value they get of our platform and the return on investment.
This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestration of other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon. This is in parallel to being technical, with expectations being that you become the post-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate at all levels with an organisation. You will report directly to a Field Engineering Manager.
The impact you will have:
Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritised customers
Lead the post-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
Be the accountable technical leader assigned to specific use cases and customer(s) across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, success, go-live and healthy consumption of the workloads where the customer has made the decision to consume Databricks
Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services and Support resources, along with escalating to expert level technical experts to build the right tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise
Create, own and execute a point-of-view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews and upgrade needs
Develop an execution plan that covers all activities of all customer-facing technical roles and teams to cover the below work streams:
Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production
Enablement / user growth plan
Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)
Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning & optimization)
Executive and operational governance
Provide internal and external updates - KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, covering investment status, important risks, product adoption and use case progression - to your Technical GM
What we look for:
8+ years of experience where you have been accountable for technical project / program delivery within the domain of Data and AI and where you can contribute to technical debate and design choices with customers
Programming experience in Python, SQL or Scala
Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role
Understanding of solution architecture related distributed data systems
Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables
Technical program, or project management including account, stakeholder and resource management accountability
Experience resolving complex and important escalation with senior customer executives
Experience conducting open-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis and managing delivery of complex programmes/projects
Track record of overachievement against quota, Goals or similar objective targets
Proficiency in Mandarin and experience in the Greater China Region are required to enable effective collaboration and understanding of client needs. The successful candidate will engage with the Greater China Region customers in Mandarin for technical sales discussions, address technical challenges, and articulate clear technical solutions and value propositions.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience
Can travel up to 30% when needed

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. job.title: Security Engineer - Detection and Response
job.description_text:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
Security engineers at Spotify protect our platform, employees, creators, and more than 700 million users. We are looking for an experienced Security Engineer to join the Detection and Response organization and help identify, investigate, and respond to threats across Spotify's environment.
You will work within our detection engineering squad where the team owns alert triage, security investigations, threat hunting, and the detection engineering lifecycle. You will turn threat intelligence, incident learnings, and analyst feedback into effective detections and investigation workflows. You will partner closely with the detection infrastructure squad, which builds and operates Detection and Response platforms and telemetry pipelines, and with teams across Spotify to make sure your squad has the signals and capabilities needed to detect and respond to threats at Spotify's scale.
We are a distributed team that values curiosity, sound judgment, clear communication, and continuous learning. We teach and learn from one another, adapt as the threat landscape changes, and focus our effort according to business needs and risk.
What You'll Do
Identify detection opportunities, define clear telemetry requirements, and partner with the detection infrastructure squad and data owners to make the signals needed for detection and investigation available.
Develop, test, tune, and maintain detections across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, email, and other security-relevant environments.
Investigate and prioritize alerts, determine their security impact, and participate in incident containment and remediation.
Build repeatable investigation workflows and playbooks for alert triage, evidence collection, decision-making, escalation, containment, and response.
Improve proactive threat-identification and threat-hunting capabilities using internal telemetry and external threat intelligence.
Create cutting-edge AI workflows for Detection and Response that enrich alerts, gather and analyze evidence, guide investigations, and automate repetitive response work while preserving appropriate human judgment and oversight.
Measure detection effectiveness, identify coverage gaps, and tune detections to balance security value, fidelity, and analyst workload.
Use SIEM, EDR, SOAR, and related security platforms to research threats, develop detections, investigate alerts, and validate security outcomes.
Share knowledge, document decisions, and communicate security findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Who You Are
You are curious, collaborative, and comfortable making progress in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment.
You have 3+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, threat detection, detection engineering, or closely related work.
You understand how analysts triage and investigate alerts and how detection quality affects their decisions and workload.
You know how to create and tune detections based on attacker behavior, available telemetry, and an expected investigation path.
You are experienced with security platforms such as SIEM, EDR, SOAR, or comparable monitoring and response technologies.
You can write code or use an automation platform to analyze security telemetry, enrich alerts, build investigation workflows, and remove repetitive work. Experience with Python or a similar language is valuable.
You understand modern detection-as-code practices, including GitHub, peer review, CI/CD, testing, and safely managing production detection content.
You have experience working with at least one major cloud platform, such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure.
You understand common threats affecting SaaS-oriented corporate and production environments.
You care about clear documentation, inclusive collaboration, and explaining security concepts to people with different backgrounds and levels of expertise.
You are excited to create and critically evaluate cutting-edge AI workflows for detection development, alert triage, security investigations, and response, while applying sound security judgment and appropriate human oversight.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in New York
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
The United States base range for this position is $132,948–$189,927 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

MongoDB is a true data platform with a comprehensive suite of tools to make working with data remarkably easy for everyone, from developers to analysts to data scientists. This role will be located in Austin, TX.
About the Role
As the Regional Director, you will drive revenue and ensure the continued successful trajectory of the territory while also focusing on recruitment, enablement, and execution for the Commercial Growth Sales Team. With a people-first culture, which is echoed throughout the whole company, managing and leading our team is top of mind. Our sales leadership is committed to building the best salesforce in technology, with a legendary reputation of excellence and integrity. This means, inspiring and enabling success for everyone on the team. We provide the opportunity for all Regional Directors to sit with their peers and collectively learn from each other about how to better develop our people, recruit, retain, and use data to get the best results for and from our people. All of us are committed to working hard to build something unparalleled in the industry.
What is Commercial Growth Sales:
The Commercial Growth Team’s mission is to drive broader revenue expansion by prioritizing accounts with high potential for multi-workload adoption, proactively retaining top accounts with strong growth trajectories, and accelerating new workload contributions through strategic use case expansion.
Our sales motion combines strategic account planning, consultative selling, and product-led insights to drive growth. By understanding customer business priorities, leveraging product usage signals, and engaging key stakeholders, we identify opportunities to modernize applications, expand workloads, and deliver measurable business outcomes. Through a value-driven, multi-threaded approach, we build stronger customer relationships, accelerate adoption, and position MongoDB as a strategic partner for long-term growth.
What you’ll be doing:
Attract, hire, and retain top sales talent, building a high-performing team of Account Executives through effective recruiting, onboarding, coaching, and career development
Build a high-performance culture rooted in accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and consistent execution to achieve and exceed sales goals.
Coach and elevate sales talent through hands-on deal strategy, MEDDIC qualification, consultative selling, executive engagement, and complex negotiations.
Drive predictable revenue growth by strengthening pipeline generation, accelerating new workload acquisition, expanding existing customer relationships, and improving deal execution
Lead a strategic Commercial Growth sales motion combining proactive prospecting, account planning, value-based selling, multi-threading, and product-led insights to capture growth opportunities
Develop deep product and market expertise to mentor AEs, navigate complex customer organizations, and position MongoDB as a strategic technology partner
Drive operational excellence through weekly forecast meetings, pipeline inspection, territory planning, and data-driven decision-making to improve predictability and sales productivity
Build strong cross-functional partnerships with Solutions Architecture, Professional Services, Customer Success, Marketing, and other stakeholders to accelerate customer outcomes and unlock growth opportunities
Shape and scale our Commercial Growth business by optimizing territory coverage, evolving go-to-market strategies, developing future leaders, and establishing repeatable best practices
What you will bring to the table:
A minimum of 1 year of experience leading a sales team in a commercial segment (SMB / Mid Market)
A true passion for sales & technology - we want leaders who love what they do and inspire their team
Experience recruiting and managing a highly successful and talented direct software sales team while driving them toward success
A proven track record of overachievement and hitting sales targets
Ability to articulate the business value of complex enterprise technology
Skilled in building business champions
Driven and competitive. Possess a strong desire to be successful
Must be based in Austin, TX
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

job.title: Senior Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
job.description_text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What Is The Role:
We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.
What You Will Be Doing:
Leveraging your distributed systems expertise to build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.
What You Bring:
You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.
You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
You have shown your ability to understand and work on complex, highly distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
You demonstrate the ability to build and debug features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities.
You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.
Bonus Points:
Data stores
Search, analytics, Lucene
Strong knowledge of the JDK
Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty.
Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.
At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.
The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

791.300 kr—1.251.700 kr NOK
Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

job.title: Founding Customer Success Manager - APAC
job.description_text:
About this Role
Our Customer Success team is passionate about shaping and scaling an exceptional enterprise customer experience globally. As we continue to grow in APAC, we are excited to hire our first Customer Success Manager in region to support our Strategic and High Touch customers in the region.
In this role, you will own a defined book of upmarket APAC customers. You will oversee the customer journey throughout long-term adoption, customer health, and value realization.
You will partner with Ashby’s customers, helping them get up and running quickly while also building deep, ongoing strategic relationships. Ashby is powerful and highly configurable, and this role requires both technical depth and customer leadership. You will develop strong product and domain expertise to help customers apply Ashby within their hiring workflows and achieve hiring excellence.
You will come into this role owning the existing book of business and work with existing customers within the market. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complexity, enjoys hands-on execution, and is excited to help shape how we support customers in a new region.
Role Requirements
Customer Success & Account Ownership
You have a strong background in Customer Success in B2B SaaS (5+ years preferred), supporting Enterprise or Strategic customers on complex, configurable products and driving adoption, engagement, and long-term outcomes.
You are excited to own a strategic book of customers in APAC and are comfortable managing a book of ~20 strategic customers, exceeding $2m in total ARR.
You build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with senior stakeholders and act as a proactive owner of customer health, risk, and value realization.
You partner closely with Sales, Product, Support, Professional Services, and Operations to deliver cohesive, high-quality customer outcomes across the full lifecycle.
You are comfortable working in a remote-first environment and can travel up to 10 percent as needed for strategic customer engagements in APAC.
Product, Technical, and Domain Expertise
You love becoming a product and industry expert. You create “aha” moments by tailoring configuration, workflows, and training to each customer’s specific hiring challenges.
You have worked with technically complex products and are deeply curious about how things work, enabling you to anticipate risks, troubleshoot issues, and support evolving customer requirements.
You take pride in advising customers on best practices to ensure they get maximum value from Ashby.
Change Management & Problem Solving
You are experienced in change management and help customers successfully adopt new systems, workflows, and ways of working.
You think critically and proactively identify themes across customers, using those insights to improve internal processes and customer playbooks.
You use data, signals, and metrics to assess adoption, spot risk, and continuously refine your approach.
You are comfortable operating as the first Customer Success hire in APAC, bringing curiosity, ownership, and initiative to develop the region, define best practices, and partnering cross-functionally.
You Should Apply If:
📣 You communicate with clarity and precision. You can distill complex workflows, reports, or technical concepts into simple, confident guidance for a range of stakeholders.
🎧 You are a listener first. You seek to deeply understand customer needs and advocate for them internally to shape how Ashby evolves for enterprise use cases.
⚙️ You thrive in complexity. You are energized by learning a powerful, configurable product and translating that knowledge into practical solutions.
🧑‍🏫 You love teaching and coaching. You see every interaction as an opportunity to help customers grow and succeed.
🔍 Your peers describe you as detail-oriented. You send crisp follow-ups, keep projects on track, and take pride in strong internal operations and CRM hygiene.
📊 You are data-driven. You use insights to evaluate what is working, identify risks, and improve outcomes over time.
🌍 You are adaptable. You are excited to help shape and evolve our enterprise and APAC customer motion as the region scales. While there are in-region Product Support Specialists and a Support Manager, you’ll be our founding CSM!
👥 You may have experience as a recruiter, hiring manager, or interviewer, which helps you quickly connect Ashby’s workflows to real-world hiring challenges (nice to have, not required).
Why you shouldn’t apply:
You are looking for a role with infrequent, transactional customer interactions instead of hands-on, ongoing partnerships.
You prefer exclusively commercial account management with variable compensation. This role focuses on adoption, engagement, and long-term value rather than renewals or upsell negotiation.
You are not excited by hands-on execution, detailed configuration, project management, or change management work.
You prefer working with simple, point-solution products rather than a deep, highly configurable platform.
About Ashby
We’re building the next generation of enterprise software and we’re starting with a suite of products that empower talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers to be a driving force for revenue & efficiency via a holistic, data-centric talent strategy.
We are well funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom. We have thousands of amazing customers including Snowflake, OpenAI, Shopify, Ramp, Notion, and Zapier (and many others who we cannot name!).
Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, over 4,000 customers, very low churn, and many years of runway. In short, it's the perfect time to join! 🚀
Interview Process
Our interview process is designed to be thorough and transparent, ensuring mutual fit for both you and Ashby. The process for this role includes:
Recruiter Screen - 30 minutes
Hiring Manager Interview -45 minutes
Mock Customer Scenario Presentation - 45 minutes
Panel Interview - 1 hour
Rather than a traditional panel interview with a large group, we structure our panel into two focused conversations. This gives you the opportunity to meet with multiple team members in a more conversational setting centered on specific topics, instead of a formal Q&A. You'll discuss how you approach problem solving, dive into a product complexity exercise, then wrap up with a quick closing call with the hiring manager.
Benefits
10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
Unlimited PTO with four weeks is recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅
Generous paid family leave.
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - Storage Engine - Elasticsearch
job.description_text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Storage Engine team. This globally distributed, fully remote team of experienced engineers develops core storage and query technologies for observability workloads, including improving storage efficiency, advancing ES|QL query processing and performance, and optimizing data layouts for object storage.
This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing Elasticsearch's core storage and query engine. The ideal candidate has experience building high-performance, scalable database, search, or distributed systems, with a strong focus on storage, indexing, query execution, and performance optimization.
Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable, intuitive and high-quality software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.
What You Will Be Doing
Lead the architectural evolution of core storage engine components, continuously identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks in indexing layouts, serialization formats, and resource utilization.
Lead cross organizational initiatives to drive and build industry-leading observability solutions.
Work with a globally distributed team of experienced engineers focused on the logs and metrics capabilities of Elasticsearch.
Drive continuous operational and system improvements by introducing best practices for clean coding standards, demystifying complex system behaviors, untangling complexity to bring architectural clarity across the platform.
Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) across key areas of Elasticsearch, acting as a trusted technical advisor and mentor to the wider engineering organization.
Work with a global community to triage, resolve, and review issues and pull requests, collaborating with domain experts as needed.
Write idiomatic modern Java -- Elasticsearch is 99.8% Java!
What You Bring
You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
You work autonomously and can drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.
You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
You bring a prompt-engineering mindset to know how to leverage AI agents effectively, using sound engineering judgment to validate results and recognize its limitations.
You have implemented novel techniques to efficiently index, store, and query time-series or logs data.
You have experience with one or more data storage technologies like Elasticsearch, Solr, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Prometheus and have some idea how they work and why they work that way.
You have strong core Java skills, a deep understanding of its concurrency primitives, with a proven ability to design and optimize efficient data structures and algorithms.
You excel in a collaborative environment, actively participate in technical discussions, and work effectively across distributed teams. Because it's the best way we know how to build software.
You have excellent verbal and written communication skills and collaborate with respect, empathy, and professionalism in a distributed team.
Bonus Points
You've built things with Elasticsearch before.
You've worked with open source projects and are familiar with different styles of source control workflow and continuous integration.
You’ve worked on data storage technology.
You have experience designing, leading, and owning cross-functional initiatives.
You have past working experience with database, search engine, OS, or cloud service development.
Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.
At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. job.title: Netsuite Systems Manager | EST United States | Remote
job.description_text:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
The Opportunity:
The Finance Systems team is seeking an experienced Netsuite Systems Manager with strong functional and IT support experience to join the team. In this individual contributor role you will be responsible for administration, configuration, and support for our Netsuite ERP system and associated Finance Business Systems. Additionally, you will be a Finance Systems thought leader and champion of best IT/functional practices, IT General controls, and process improvement automation. Reporting directly to Sr Director of Finance Systems, you will collaborate closely with Business Application, Sales Operations, IT, and our Finance team. This position is 100% remote.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Netsuite System Administration
Own day-to-day operations of NetSuite, and other Finance Business systems including hands on user support and troubleshooting.
Administer and support the NetSuite ERP system, focusing on Financial, Advanced Revenue Management (ARM), and Zone billing module
Perform system configuration, customization, upgrade and maintenance along with compliance in change management, ITGC, and SDLC processes.
Develop and maintain workflows, custom fields, and scripts.
Manage NetSuite integrations with other business systems.
Oversee user access management, SOD Reviews, and annual/quarterly review process to resolve segregation of duties conflicts.
Oversee the governance, change management, end to end maintenance including general ledger accounts, cost centers, products, and any other necessary structures to support the reporting needs of key stakeholders. Manage ticketing system for tracking open cases/change request to resolution
Optimize system settings, workflows, and customizations for maximum efficiency.
Ensure data integrity and compliance with SOX regulations.
Provide training and support to end-users.
Program Management
Manage/Configure finance transformation projects focusing primarily on the order to cash cycle, encompassing Lead/Opportunity, Contract Management, Quoting/CPQ, Order Management, Revenue Recognition, Billing, Credit, Collections/Disputes, and Cash Application processes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Sales, Legal,Engineering, Finance and IT to gather requirements and implement solutions that enhance business processes.
Identify, scope, and prioritize projects based on business needs. Develop detailed project plans, including approach, timelines, milestones, and resources, ensuring on-time and within-budget project delivery.
Define data-driven frameworks and processes to identify, measure, and manage program success, focusing on business value, including benchmarking.
Ensure procedures, processes, and proper change controls are followed on all production changes and implementation projects
Work with sales operations and biz app teams on system enhancements.
Dashboard Creation and Reporting
Utilize NetSuite's native tools and our very own Grafana dashboard to create high-performing dashboards tailored to Finance needs.
Develop reports and visualizations to provide actionable insights from finance data.
What Makes You a Great Fit:
Bachelor’s Degree or higher in computer Science, information technology, accounting, finance or a related field.
6+ years of progressive experience with as a Finance System Administrator with Netsuite and financial systems tools such as Zip, Avalara, Expensify etc
Hands-on IT support experience, including troubleshooting and resolving functional & technical issues.
Experience with data migration, data mapping, and data integration within Netsuite including the Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) module including Zone and Company billing module,and Salesforce integration.
Administrator-level knowledge of privileged access, content groups, multiple charts of accounts, dynamic approval chains, custom objects, tax codes, tolerances, custom workflows, supplier configuration, and report building
Knowledge of ITGCs and experience working in SOC, ISO, and SOX compliant environments
Demonstrated experience integrating accounting systems with Salesforce / SFDC, ideally including CPQ and experienced level with Netsuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM)
Experience with project management concepts and tools such as Github, Monday.com and Miro.
Sharp analytical skills coupled with the ability to troubleshoot complex system issues with ease
Knowledge of core accounting processes such as order to cash, procure to pay, record to report.
Highly motivated with the ability to work in a rapidly changing global and remote environment
You work well in both a team environment and independently
Excellent communication skills with the ability to speak cross-functionally
Compensation & Rewards:
In the United States, the Base compensation range for this role is $148,000 - $178,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.
*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.
Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:
100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.
Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. job.title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Foundations
job.description_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll help lead two important areas for GitLab Security: the data layer behind our vulnerability and dependency management capabilities, and our move toward services outside the GitLab monolith. You'll design and develop systems that ingest, store, index, and query security report data, including integrations with key third-party systems. With a strong focus on PostgreSQL and scalable backend design, your work will support security features delivered by teams across GitLab.
You'll take ownership of large deliverables from early ideas through implementation, working directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to shape the technical and product roadmap. You'll stay hands-on across GitLab's Ruby on Rails application and newer services, including greenfield projects, while helping the team build its expertise in modular service design.
What you’ll do
Lead large technical deliverables from initial problem definition through delivery, often across multiple months or quarters.
Design and develop backend systems for vulnerability and dependency management, including security report ingestion, storage, indexing, querying, and integrations with key third-party systems.
Build and improve systems using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, and contribute to newer services using technologies such as Go or Rust where appropriate.
Shape technical plans, break down complex work, and help other engineers deliver effectively.
Work directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to make clear decisions, resolve constraints, and deliver measurable progress.
Influence the team's product and technical roadmap through hands-on investigation, clear proposals, and iterative delivery that demonstrates progress in each monthly release cycle.
Apply a security mindset when designing systems, including considering how GitLab identifies and handles malicious or vulnerable software packages.
Define patterns for modular services, provide technical leadership when vulnerability management work spans multiple GitLab areas, and share that expertise across GitLab Security.
Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
What you’ll bring
Experience leading complex backend projects from idea through delivery while remaining hands-on with design and development.
Strong PostgreSQL experience, including evidence of query optimization, table optimization, and write-ahead log management in data-intensive systems.
Strong professional experience with Ruby on Rails or Go and comfort working in Ruby on Rails day to day. Experience with large monoliths is helpful, along with an interest in working across languages and services.
Experience shaping delivery plans, guiding technical decisions, and supporting the work of other engineers.
The ability to collaborate with a range of partners and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
Experience communicating with leaders, leading peers through complex delivery, identifying constraints, and moving work forward.
Experience using security tooling for activities such as vulnerability triage and remediation, or professional experience building vulnerability management, dependency management, or related security products.
Experience with large-scale data systems or established software products. We welcome transferable experience from outside the security domain.
Fluency in using artificial intelligence tools to improve delivery while applying sound engineering judgment.
About the team
The Vulnerability Management team contributes to GitLab's move toward modular services and will help other Security teams adopt these patterns over time. Today, we include two Staff Software Engineers, two Senior Software Engineers, and one Intermediate Software Engineer across the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, and India. You'll work closely with us, product partners, and engineering leaders across GitLab.
We work with clear goals and shared priorities. You'll receive clear context and outcomes, then have the space to own delivery, communicate decisions and progress, ask for help early, and work directly with the partners needed to get the job done.
How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees
Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

job.title: Manager, Client Platform Engineering
job.description_text:
We are looking for a Manager, Client Platform Engineering to own MongoDB's endpoint platform worldwide. You'll lead a globally distributed team responsible for macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints, mobile device and application management, zero-touch provisioning, on-time operating system and patch delivery, and the endpoint telemetry that tells us how the fleet is performing for the people using it. You'll partner with InfoSec to harden the endpoint estate, and build and grow a team of passionate, curious experts in this space. This role combines deep hands-on end user computing expertise with the people leadership and judgment to set technical direction and communicate risk and strategy to stakeholders.
What You'll Do
Own the worldwide endpoint architecture and roadmap for macOS, Windows, Linux, and mobile, including management platform strategy, configuration-as-code, application packaging and self-service, and zero-touch provisioning
Lead the release calendar and deployment ring strategy for every endpoint operating system, delivering major and minor updates on time to a published compliance target, with tested rollback and a clear exception path
Administer and evolve MongoDB's endpoint management stack across MDM and UEM platforms, including declarative device management (DDM) on macOS and Windows Autopilot and Autopatch on Windows 11
Own mobile strategy end to end for corporate-owned and BYOD devices across iOS and Android, balancing data protection against an enrollment experience employees will accept MDM where enrollment is appropriate, MAM and app protection policies where it is not
Build and operate MongoDB's Endpoint Digital Employee Experience program: instrument the fleet, define the DEX metrics and SLOs we hold ourselves to, and drive proactive remediation that resolves issues before employees notice them
Partner with InfoSec to implement and continuously improve endpoint security controls, including hardening baselines, patch and vulnerability remediation SLAs, disk encryption and key escrow coverage, device trust, and Conditional Access
Serve as a senior technical escalation point (L3) for complex endpoint issues across the organization
Build automation to reduce manual endpoint operations work and improve reliability and observability, holding the team to configuration-as-code, peer review, and staged rollout
Act as a technical advisor for MongoDB's relationships with endpoint management, DEX, and hardware vendors, and own the endpoint tooling and licensing budget
Hire, coach, and retain a globally distributed team of EUC engineers, and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and self-service
Responsibilities
Ensure MongoDB's global endpoint fleet remains reliable, secure, compliant, and scalable across every platform and region as the company grows
Deliver operating system rollouts on time, every cycle, across macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints
Reduce risk and technical debt across endpoint management, patching, and device lifecycle
Build and maintain a high-performing international team, and develop engineers into recognized experts in this space
Communicate endpoint strategy, risk, and incidents clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Uphold strong engineering practices across endpoint documentation, automation, and change management
Balance long-term platform architecture work with day-to-day operational support
Define, publish, and manage the team against the metrics for the service
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience
8+ years of experience in end user computing, client platform engineering, or endpoint and modern workplace engineering, including 3+ years hiring and leading engineers
Proven experience owning a fleet of several thousand endpoints across multiple countries and time zones
Hands-on depth across all three desktop platforms, not oversight of them: macOS managed through a modern MDM (Jamf Pro, Iru/formerly Kandji, Microsoft Intune, or Omnissa Workspace ONE) with Apple Business (formerly Apple Business Manager) and Automated Device Enrollment; Windows 11 managed through Intune, Windows Autopilot, and Windows Autopatch; Linux endpoints managed as code with Ansible, Fleet, or equivalent
A current understanding of Apple's declarative device management (DDM) model and what its adoption means for software update enforcement, Platform SSO, and configuration and app delivery
Experience with both mobile management models: MDM for corporate-owned devices and MAM/app protection for BYOD, including Intune App Protection Policies, Android Enterprise work profile, and Apple User Enrollment with Managed Apple Accounts
A demonstrated record of delivering major OS rollouts on schedule, with a defined ring strategy, compatibility gating, communications plan, exception process, and rollback path
Experience instrumenting endpoints with a DEX or telemetry platform such as Nexthink, Lakeside SysTrack, ControlUp, 1E, Aternity, Intune Advanced Analytics, or osquery/Fleet, defining a score or SLO from it, and using it to resolve issues proactively
Scripting skills for endpoint automation using infrastructure as code, with fluency in at least one of Bash, Python, Swift, or PowerShell and comfort with Git-based workflows
Experience partnering with InfoSec, Identity, IT Service Delivery, and Workplace teams on cross-functional endpoint initiatives
Experience leading engineers across multiple regions, with a clear approach to coverage, escalation, documentation, and asynchronous decision-making
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to a wide range of audiences
Experience with endpoint documentation and reporting such as fleet compliance dashboards, configuration baselines, and operational runbooks
There will be requirements from time to time to work across multiple time zones as required by the business, including travel
Preferred Qualifications
Jamf Certified Expert, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or equivalent endpoint management certification
Visible standing in the endpoint community — MacAdmins Slack, Jamf Nation, Midwest Management Summit, Penn State MacAdmins — or open-source contributions to projects such as Munki, Installomator, Nudge, swiftDialog, or osquery
Experience supporting a heavily technical employee population, including software engineers with elevated-privilege, virtualization, and local developer and AI tooling needs
Experience with cloud identity and device trust platforms such as Okta and Microsoft Entra ID, and with Conditional Access policy design
Familiarity with ITSM practice, service ownership, and Experience Level Agreements (XLAs) alongside traditional SLAs
Experience owning endpoint tooling budget, vendor relationships, and licensing at scale
Experience mentoring other endpoint or systems engineers
Success Measures
In 3 months, you will: Be fully onboarded with a thorough understanding of MongoDB's endpoint estate and policies, have met your team and key partners in every region, and have delivered a written assessment of the worldwide fleet — platform coverage, compliance posture, tooling, gaps, and top risks — with a prioritized plan and any approved roles actively in flight
In 6 months, you will: Have your team at or above 90% of the approved hiring plan, have published the EUC service metrics and SLOs (OS and patch compliance, zero-touch provisioning rate, mean time to provision, DEX score, self-service resolution rate), have shipped at least one major OS release on schedule under a defined ring strategy, and have closed the highest-priority gaps identified in your assessment
In 12 months, you will: Be recognized as the senior owner of MongoDB's global endpoint platform, operating a fully staffed, high-performing international team; consistently meeting your published OS and patch compliance targets across macOS, Windows, and Linux; running a measurable proactive remediation program with a demonstrated reduction in endpoint tickets per employee; and owning a twelve-month endpoint roadmap that InfoSec, IT, and Engineering leadership have endorsed
Location & Travel:
This role is based in Palo Alto / San Francisco, CA, and candidates should be located within reasonable commuting distance of our Palo Alto and San Francisco offices
The team operates with a flexible work arrangement, with in-person collaboration typically occurring 1–2 times per week
This role involves travel and regular work across time zones to lead a globally distributed team and to support global office and regional IT initiatives
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. job.description_text:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
About the Role
Fivetran + dbt Labs is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. We’re looking for a Senior Staff Systems Engineer, Data and Integrations to join our Systems Engineering team and set the technical direction for the data that runs Fivetran's business. In this role, you will own the data architecture behind our marketing, sales, billing, and product operations: the canonical data models, the contracts between systems, and the pipelines and transformations that move data reliably between them. You will lead our largest and most consequential data initiatives, such as system migrations, org consolidations, and re-platforming of core integrations, from design through validation and cutover.
This position sits at the crossroads of data engineering, data modeling, and business process. You will partner closely with our Systems, Analytics, and Engineering teams, as well as Marketing, Revenue Operations, Accounting, Product Operations, and other business partner teams, and you will mentor the engineers who build within the standards you set.
This is a full-time position based out of our Oakland, California office.
Technologies You’ll Use
Our core systems are Salesforce, Netsuite, Coupa, Workday, and Zendesk, with BigQuery as our data warehouse. Our current integration stack includes Celigo and Fivetran itself. You should be an expert in SQL and strong in a general purpose programming language such as Python or TypeScript, and comfortable evaluating and adopting new tools when necessary.
A data engineering background is required, with expertise in data modeling, ETL/ELT development, data quality testing, and data validation at scale. Experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework, and with API-based and event-driven integration patterns, is preferred. Help us bring established data engineering practices to internal business systems, and define what those practices should be here.
What You’ll Do
Data Architecture and Standards
Own the canonical data models for Fivetran's marketing, sales, billing, and product operations integrations, and define how business concepts map to data across our core systems.
Define team-wide standards for data modeling, data quality, testing, governance, and documentation, and drive their adoption across Systems Engineering and partner teams.
Contribute to the design of integration architecture, establishing guidance for when to use batch, real-time, and event-driven data movement.
Delivery of Complex Initiatives
Lead the design and execution of our most complex data initiatives, including bulk migrations, system consolidations, and re-implementation of core integrations, from target-state design through validation, cutover, and stabilization.
Build, review, and ship the SQL and Python transformations and pipelines behind these initiatives, setting the bar for code quality on the team.
Design the validation and reconciliation approach for migrations and pipeline changes, and sign off with stakeholders that record counts, values, and business rules reconcile.
Reliability and Observability
Design the monitoring, alerting, and data quality framework that gives end-to-end visibility into data freshness and accuracy across systems, and define the KPIs used to measure integration and data health.
Lead root cause analysis on the most complex cross-system data issues, and drive the systemic fixes that prevent recurrence.
Business Partnership Technical Leadership
Translate ambiguous requirements from cross-functional business partners into data models and technical designs, and drive alignment across teams with competing priorities.
Serve as the technical lead and subject matter expert for business data within the Systems Engineering team.
Mentor other engineers and review their designs and code, raising the team's proficiency in data modeling, testing, and pipeline design.
Write and maintain design documents and data flow documentation for current and target state, so decisions are legible to the team and to partners.
Skills We’re Looking For
10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or a similar role, with a deep focus on modeling and transforming business data and a track record of technical leadership on complex, multi-team initiatives.
Expert SQL proficiency, including complex transformations, performance tuning, and large-scale data reconciliation.
Strong proficiency in a general purpose programming language such as Python or TypeScript, with experience building production-grade, tested data pipelines.
Hands-on experience with business systems data models such as those for Salesforce, NetSuite, Coupa, Workday, or Zendesk, including a data migration, org merge, or major re-implementation.
Demonstrated experience designing and delivering large-scale ETL/ELT solutions and the data quality, validation, and governance frameworks around them.
Ability to evaluate trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term data architecture health, and to communicate those decisions clearly.
Ability to lead through influence, driving alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders without direct authority.
Bonus Skills
Experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework.
Hands-on experience with iPaaS platforms such as Celigo, Workato, or Boomi, and with reverse ETL tools, including experience choosing between them.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD for data pipelines.
Familiarity with AI/ML capabilities to augment data quality, matching, and automation.
By stepping into this role, you will define how Fivetran's + dbt Labs business data is modeled, governed, and moved, and lead the initiatives that make it scale.

job.title: Analytics Engineer Sênior
job.description_text:
No Grupo Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.
Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!
Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!
Sobre a posição
Como Analytics Engineer Sênior, você liderará a refatoração e padronização da nossa camada de transformação no GCP. Sua missão é erradicar consultas SQL monolíticas ("código espaguete") e lógicas duplicadas, implementando engenharia de software aplicada ao SQL (Dataform/dbt), testes de qualidade embutidos e templates que servirão de base para nossa aceleração via IA (Antigravity).
Responsabilidades
Modularidade de Desenvolvimento: Definir e implementar os padrões de engenharia SQL no BigQuery utilizando Dataform (com desenvolvimento de pacotes/macros em JavaScript/TypeScript) e/ou dbt (Jinja/Python), estruturando camadas claras de transformação, reuso de código, modelagem dimensional/denormalizada eficiente (uso estratégico de STRUCT e ARRAY) e padrões estritos de cargas incrementais (incremental tables com merge/insert-overwrite por partição), evitando full-refreshes desnecessários e garantindo idempotência nos reprocessamentos.
Qualidade de Dados Automatizada: Implementar frameworks de Data Quality (assertions no Dataform / Dataplex Auto Data Quality) e o padrão arquitetural Write-Audit-Publish (WAP) no BigQuery, garantindo que dados recém-processados sejam auditados e que anomalias, quebras de chave ou atrasos de SLA acionem Circuit Breakers e bloqueiem a propagação de dados corrompidos antes de serem expostos às views de consumo final.
Padrões para Geração via IA: Estruturar os modelos e templates de transformação de excelência, mantendo um repositório de "Few-Shot Examples" (exemplos canônicos de Staging, Intermediate e Marts) perfeitamente documentados que servirão de contexto para o Antigravity gerar novos modelos de dados de forma padronizada.
Camada Semântica e Self-Service: Trabalhar próximo às áreas consumidoras para desenhar camadas semânticas e Data Marts otimizados no BigQuery (via Views Autorizadas, Tabelas Agregadas e Materialized Views aceleradas pelo BI Engine) para ferramentas de visualização (especialmente Looker Studio), garantindo alta performance, baixo custo de leitura e consistência absoluta de KPIs mesmo em ferramentas que não possuem camada de modelagem centralizada nativa.
Requisitos Técnicos
Domínio absoluto de SQL avançado no BigQuery (Window Functions / QUALIFY, manipulação avançada de UNNEST / ARRAY_AGG, scripting procedural) e ferramentas modernas de transformação modular: Dataform (incluindo JavaScript para geração dinâmica de SQL) e/ou dbt (Jinja).
Experiência profunda em modelagem de dados para Cloud Data Warehouses (Kimball adaptado para bancos colunares, One Big Table com campos aninhados RECORD/REPEATED, modelagem histórica Slowly Changing Dimensions - SCD Tipo 2, técnicas de Partition Pruning, Clustering em chaves de alta cardinalidade e modelagem incremental para redução de bytes escaneados e consumo de slots).
Experiência com integração, catalogação e otimização de fontes de dados para ferramentas de BI, com destaque para Looker Studio e BI Engine (uso de Materialized Views, pré-agregações, gerenciamento de concorrência e prevenção de queries full-scan disparadas por filtros mal configurados no Looker Studio).
Vivência comprovada na criação de testes automatizados de dados (schema tests, testes de integridade referencial, detecção de anomalias de volume e atualização).
Competências comportamentais
Ponte entre Negócio e Engenharia: Você possui excelente articulação verbal e visual para traduzir regras de negócio complexas em modelos de dados limpos — e sabe explicar essa estrutura tanto para um diretor comercial quanto para um engenheiro de dados.
Rigor Técnico com Pragmatismo: Você tem uma obsessão saudável por código limpo, modular e bem documentado, sabendo evangelizar boas práticas de Analytics Engineering de forma consultiva e colaborativa.
Mentalidade de Produto (Data-as-a-Product): Você enxerga tabelas e camadas semânticas como produtos que precisam de SLA, documentação clara e confiança do usuário final.
Pensamento Analítico e Investigativo: Capacidade de realizar análises de causa raiz (RCA) rápidas quando divergências de números surgem entre sistemas legados e a nova camada semântica.
Diferenciais
Experiência na migração de pipelines legados (Stored Procedures monolíticas ou queries agendadas no BigQuery) para arquiteturas modulares no Dataform/dbt.
Conhecimento em ferramentas de camada semântica dedicada (LookML / Looker, Cube, dbt Semantic Layer) ou design de métricas padronizadas.
Experiência em análise de grafo de linhagem (DAG) para identificação de gargalos críticos de SLA e refatoração de dependências circulares ou excessivamente profundas.
Informações adicionais
🍛 Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;
👨🏼‍🎓 Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;
📚 Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;
🗣 Mentoring;
💉 Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;
🏥 Assistência médica;
🦷 Assistência odontológica;
💰 Clube de vantagens e descontos nos melhores estabelecimentos;
🛫 Clube de viagens;
🐶 Convênio para pets.

job.title: Software Engineer 3, Data Pipeline
job.description_text:
The Data Pipeline team, within the MongoDB Observability organization, builds and supports scalable, highly available capabilities for transporting and transforming telemetry data across MongoDB. The team's mission is to provide a unified streaming pipeline that ingests data and processes high-throughput telemetry, enabling the migration of legacy observability solutions within MongoDB.
Built on a diskless, Kafka-compatible data streaming platform as the core streaming bus and Apache Flink for real-time transformations and delivery to storage, the platform lives on Kubernetes clusters and enables downstream consumers to access live telemetry for immediate analysis and reliable long-term retention. The main concern of this team is to provide reliable systems with high availability and replay capabilities.
About the role
We're looking for a Software Engineer 3 to help build and operate this platform. This is an individual contributor role that combines hands-on software development with systems and site reliability engineering. You'll contribute code and ship backend improvements, while also troubleshooting production issues and helping keep the services reliable.
If you enjoy both building distributed systems and understanding how they behave in production, this role offers the opportunity to work on high-volume telemetry processing with meaningful operational responsibility. You'll contribute to medium-sized technical projects and grow with support from experienced engineers.
We are looking to speak to candidates based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.
We're looking for someone who
Enjoys working with other engineers, is approachable and curious, and is open to feedback
Has experience with Kafka-compatible streaming platforms, Apache Flink, or comparable stream-processing technologies
Has experience writing production backend systems in a compiled language, such as Java, Go, C, or C++
Has experience designing and developing scalable distributed services, with an understanding of performance, availability, and failure handling
Has worked with event-driven systems, ingestion pipelines, or high-throughput data processing
Has hands-on experience managing the development and release lifecycle on Kubernetes clusters using GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux
Has hands-on experience applying a data-driven approach to debugging and troubleshooting production systems using tools such as profilers and flame graphs to collect evidence
Is comfortable being part of 24/7 on-call rotations
Can explain their own technical contributions, the trade-offs they made, and the evidence used to evaluate results
Has a strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and time and space complexity
Nice to haves
Experience with telemetry, metrics, logs, or observability infrastructure
Experience using service-level indicators, objectives, or agreements to guide reliability improvements
Experience improving monitoring, alerting, incident response, or operational automation
Role responsibilities
Design, write, test and maintain backend code and features for the Data Pipeline platform
Contribute to and lead medium-sized technical projects through production delivery
Help improve the scalability, availability, and reliability of telemetry ingestion, transformation, and delivery to downstream storage
Investigate production issues using metrics, logs, and other evidence, and contribute to fixes and preventative improvements
Participate in the team's on-call rotation and support customer escalations with support engineers and teammates
Be customer-driven by collaborating with the sister teams and customers to improve the Observability user experience
Contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, coding best practices, and operational improvements
Success measures
In 1 month, you'll be familiar with the systems the Data Pipeline team owns, the telemetry flow and the team's development practices, and you'll have completed minor codebase tasks
In 3 months, you'll be contributing to the design and development of team projects and shipping changes regularly
In 6 months, you'll be taking on small and medium-sized projects, contributing actively to technical discussions, proactively improving the platform, supporting customer escalations, and participating in the on-call rotation
