job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance | Ireland | Remote
job.description_text:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the UK, Ireland, Spain, Germany or Sweden.
Senior Software Engineer - Security Assurances
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance to join our GRC engineering team. We are building a security system that’s automated at scale, rigorously data-driven, and built from the ground up with defense-in-depth and self-healing in mind. We support a highly autonomous, remote-first, cloud-native organization. We are a technical team that can build any tool we need, while knowing when to buy to improve velocity.
To support our growth and ambitious vision, we embrace agile principles and values, share openly, apply context-driven security mechanisms, default to action, and have an OSS-first mindset. We are a 100% remote company. We believe in high-velocity but sustainable expectations and timeframes, giving people the room to do great work.
The Opportunity:
You will work to build out our security observability, compliance, and control management systems and tools. You will develop services and tools to proactively defend our systems, provide visibility to our security state, and give engineers and stakeholders guardrails and paved roads to behave securely. You will collaborate across your team, the security department, and wider Grafana to write and deploy security policies across all of our SDLC, applications, and infrastructure.
This is a very technical, hands-on keyboard software engineering, so development experience is critical. You will ideally have some experience building, implementing and improving the maturity of security programs in Cloud-based SaaS organizations. Knowledge of security standards and frameworks (ISO, FedRAMP, PCI-DSS, GDPR, etc) is useful, but the disposition to quickly learn new things is more important than rote knowledge. You will work alongside other security engineers, full-stack developers, and customer-facing teams. Experience guiding and negotiating with peers, stakeholders, customers, and auditors is a plus.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Be a technical contributor on our GRC team covering a range of areas, including certifications, application, build, cloud, and supply chain security, and internal security tooling development
Develop, implement, and maintain highly automated security assurance programs to ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIST, PCI-DSS, TISAX, whatever else our customers eventually throw at us)
Develop systems, automations, and methods of security observability to push the GRC engineering organization beyond just meeting certification requirements
Deploy security and compliance checks in an employee-enabling way (guardrails and paved roads) in their daily workflows and build pipelines
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security controls into the software development lifecycle and operational processes.
Respond to customer security issues, security alerts, and potential incidents
What Makes You a Great Fit:
Experience developing in a production environment with at least one programming language. We primarily use Go, TypeScript, and Python but most languages translate well. You will take a code screen and be expected to discuss programming principles such as algorithms, data structures, and optimization
Knowledge of using and securing containerized, cloud-native applications, ideally with Kubernetes. Experience with multiple cloud providers is a strong plus
Experience in automating security and compliance processes using tools, scripts, and frameworks while enabling developer and employee workflows
Strong interpersonal skills, as this position will require communication with peers, stakeholders, auditors, and customers
Understanding of industry-recognized security frameworks, standards, and certifications, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST, or GDPR, and how to apply them without added operational burden. You can gain this by reading the standards documents and audit guidance
A degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience)
Bonus Points For:
Working knowledge of Grafana Labs OSS projects and products. Experience in using observability tooling to solve security problems.
Experience working with OSS communities
Experience in using technical automations to prove infrastructure compliance
Experience securing large-scale distributed systems running in public clouds
In Ireland, the base compensation range for this role is €104,000 - €124,800. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.
*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.
Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:
100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.
Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

job.description_text:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
About the Role
Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.
We're looking for an amazing individual to join Fivetran's Employee Experience team as our Senior Lead, Employee Experience & Internal Communications. This role goes beyond writing great comms — you'll also help design how employees experience Fivetran day to day, from how we listen to them, to how we recognize them, to how we bring them together as a community. You'll craft compelling communications for employees around the world, build the frameworks that connect employees to one another and to our priorities, and design programs that make people feel heard, valued, and energized — all in service of our company mission.
You'll be hands-on: writing stellar communications, designing employee listening mechanisms, building recognition programs, and running culture and community initiatives. You'll also zoom out — building frameworks and cadences that scale, and using data (surveys, engagement metrics, attendance, participation) to tell a story about how the organization is doing and what to do next.

Google Suite, Notion

Internal Communications
Own the internal communications strategy, calendar, and multi-channel distribution framework, spanning both the People and COO organizations
Write and edit clear, engaging content for internal audiences across our internal wiki and other channels
Craft consistent messaging on company updates, initiatives, and achievements
Support leadership on change and reorg communications, ensuring transparency and buy-in
Manage and optimize internal communication channels (email, intranet, Slack, and other digital platforms)
Develop and maintain a crisis communications plan for unexpected events affecting the company and its employees
Employee Listening
Design and run an employee listening framework across employee groups (e.g., ERGs) and around key moments (e.g., reorgs), at a minimum quarterly cadence
Establish feedback mechanisms to gauge the effectiveness of communications and programs, and translate what you hear into action

Integrate recognition into everyday tools and processes (e.g., Slack, Workday) and align it with company values
Culture
Identify and help launch culture initiatives grounded in our top company values
Track and report on awareness and adoption (e.g., through the annual company survey)
Events & Community
Design a connection framework for events and community programming, including remote/distributed hubs
Plan and deliver company events (holiday, community, and milestone moments) with clear attendance and satisfaction goals
Data & Storytelling
Analyze and present data (survey results, attendance, engagement, participation) accurately and use it to tell a clear story that drives decisions
Skills We’re Looking For
6+ years of experience across internal communications and employee experience/engagement, with excellent, clear, simple writing
Demonstrated experience designing employee listening, feedback, or survey programs
Experience building or running employee recognition programs
Experience planning and executing company-wide events or community programming, including for distributed/remote teams
Strong ability to analyze and present data accurately, and use it to tell a story
Ability to prioritize effectively and lead and execute independently as a senior individual contributor
Experience working cross-collaboratively with employees and executives at all levels
Fluent in best practices across internal communication channels
Understanding of how communications, recognition, culture, and leadership intersect
Experience driving behavior change through communications and program design
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Bonus Skills​
Previous experience in founder-led startup organizations
Experience with Notion
Fluency with AI tool

job.title: Software Engineering Manager - Global UX - Applications - Platform
job.description_text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
In this role, you will manage the engineering team for Global UX. This team is in charge of Elastic UI (EUI), which is Elastic's design system and React component library. They also oversee the shared patterns, tokens, and tools that ensure Elastic products are consistent, accessible, and high-quality.
You will work closely with the team's Tech Lead, who is in charge of the technical direction and architecture. You will oversee the people, roadmap, and delivery aspects of the team. This means hiring and developing engineers, creating a realistic roadmap, and ensuring the team aligns with Design leadership and Product Management on what gets built and when.
We are looking for an Engineering Manager with experience leading design system or platform teams. The ideal candidate knows how to balance long-term investments with ongoing requests from other teams. They should also be able to create a dependable delivery schedule for the whole organization.
What You Will Be Doing
Manage and grow a team of engineers responsible for building and maintaining Elastic UI (EUI) and other shared design system infrastructure across Global UX.
Own the team's delivery cadence - sprint planning, quarterly roadmap, outcomes, and status reporting to stakeholders across Elastic.
Run hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career growth for engineers on the team.
Build strong team culture and health in a fully distributed, async-first environment.
Represent Global UX in cross-functional planning with other engineering, design, and product leadership across Elastic.
Remove blockers for the team: negotiate dependencies with other teams, address organizational friction, and escalate risks early.
Track adoption and health metrics for the design system (usage, satisfaction, migration progress) and use them to inform roadmap priorities.
Build relationships with teams that consume the design system, gathering feedback and making sure their needs shape the roadmap.
Support the team's experiments with AI-assisted design-to-code workflows and developer tools. Balance innovation with delivery commitments.
What You Bring
Previous experience managing engineering teams that build and maintain design systems, component libraries, or similarly widely-consumed shared UI or platform infrastructure.
Experience running delivery cadence - sprint planning, quarterly planning, roadmapping, and outcomes for a team that serves many internal stakeholders.
Working knowledge of frontend engineering (React, TypeScript, component architecture) sufficient to make credible technical tradeoffs alongside your Tech Lead and engineers.
Experience hiring, developing, and retaining engineers, with a track record of growing people into more senior roles.
Robust stakeholder management skills. Comfortable sharing the roadmap, tradeoffs, and risks with engineering, design, and product leaders.
A track record of balancing platform and foundational investment against the urgent feature requests of consuming teams.
Deep written and verbal communication skills, with experience working in a distributed, async-first team.
Experience using data and adoption metrics (usage, satisfaction, migration progress) to inform roadmap decisions.
A collaborative leadership style that earns trust from your engineering team without needing to be the most technical person in the room.
Curiosity about how AI is changing design-to-code workflows and developer tooling, and comfort helping a team adopt new practices responsibly.

job.title: Senior Engineering Manager, dbt Engine
job.description_text:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
About the Role
We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Core team behind dbt V2, dbt’s next-generation engine. This is a backfill role for an engineering leader who can combine strong software-engineering judgment with people leadership, product partnership, and the ability to navigate a highly cross-functional technical area.
The Core team is responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the Rust-based engine that powers dbt Fusion. The team primarily works on the dbt V2 runtime itself, SQL language features powered by Static Analysis, and new ELT primitives.
The role sits at the center of several parts of the dbt product: the engine and orchestration, the IDE and developer experience, adapters and data warehouses, and our new compute offering, LakeCompute. You’ll help the team make sound technical and product decisions while keeping a stable GA product moving forward.
About the Team
The Core team is part of a broader organization that includes adapters, growth, the VS Code extension, compute, and other closely connected teams. It partners frequently with Product and with the teams responsible for orchestration, IDE experiences, adapters, and LakeCompute.
In this role, you can expect to:
Lead, coach, and develop a fluid team of approximately 8 engineers working on a critical part of the dbt product.
Establish clarity across a technically demanding roadmap with multiple product and engineering stakeholders.
Partner closely with Product to translate ambiguous requirements into realistic engineering scope, sequencing, and estimates.
Help the team balance new feature development, engine maintenance, framework modernization, documentation, and the stability of a GA product.
Guide end-to-end technical design across the engine and its integration points with orchestration, the IDE, adapters, warehouses, and late compute.
Support engineers in making sound tradeoffs across product value, technical quality, performance, compatibility, and delivery risk.
Actively contribute to technical design and implementation alongside the team.
Work with peer engineering leaders to coordinate initiatives that span multiple teams and systems.
Build an environment where engineers can do high-quality work, grow their scope, and take ownership of meaningful technical problems.
Help shape the next phase of dbt Fusion as a language-aware transformation engine used by the broader data community.
Mandatory skills
Experience leading teams through multiple concurrent priorities and diverse integration points.
Strong software-engineering fundamentals and prior experience as a senior/staff engineer, technical lead, or equivalent hands-on technical leader.
Ability to lead or facilitate system design from problem definition through implementation and delivery.
Ability to translate complex or ambiguous product requirements into credible engineering estimates, milestones, and tradeoffs.
Demonstrated judgment in balancing roadmap delivery with reliability, maintainability, technical debt, and product quality.
A hands-on technical orientation, including a willingness and ability to stay close to code and engineering details.
You are a good fit if you have:
Led a software team through the full development lifecycle: discovery, design, implementation, testing, release, operation, and iteration.
Worked on products with substantial technical complexity, integration surfaces, or platform dependencies.
Successfully partnered with Product and other engineering teams to create a stable roadmap and make difficult prioritization decisions.
Experience in data transformation, orchestration, query engines, databases, developer tools, compilers, language tooling, or a closely related area. Direct dbt experience is helpful but not required.
The ability to explain complex technical systems clearly to engineers, product partners, and candidates with different levels of technical depth.
A track record of developing strong engineers while maintaining a high technical bar.
Comfort operating in a fluid environment where team boundaries, priorities, and scope may evolve.
You’ll have an edge if you have:
Experience with Rust or another systems programming language, compilers, query planning, language servers, IDE tooling, or developer platforms.
Experience building or operating data transformation, orchestration, warehouse, or execution systems.
Contributions to open-source projects or experience working with open standards and open technical communities.
Familiarity with ecosystems such as Apache Arrow, Apache Iceberg, DuckDB, ADBC, or related data and execution technologies.
Experience with SQL semantics, query optimization, transpilation across dialects, data lineage, governance, or developer-facing language features.
Experience working in a remote-first or distributed organization with strong written communication practices.
Startup or scale-up experience and comfort wearing multiple hats while the organization evolves.

job.title: Senior Java Developer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
job.description_text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What Is The Role:
We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Developer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.
What You Will Be Doing:
Leveraging your distributed systems expertise to build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.
What You Bring:
You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.
You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
You have shown your ability to understand and work on complex, highly distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
You demonstrate the ability to build and debug features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities.
You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.
Bonus Points:
Data stores
Search, analytics, Lucene
Strong knowledge of the JDK

ClickHouse is an open-source company building the fastest and most resource-efficient real-time data platform. Our documentation is a core part of how users learn, adopt, and succeed with ClickHouse.
Our Docs team is deeply technical, independently able to use our products, read source code, test behavior, and write accurate, high-quality documentation from scratch. The team also enables contributions from across the organization and open-source community, ensuring the documentation remains consistent, discoverable, and trustworthy.
Beyond the content, the Docs team owns the documentation infrastructure as a critical, production-facing service. Its availability, performance, and reliability directly affect our users' ability to work with ClickHouse. The team is responsible for building, operating, and continuously improving this experience.
We're looking for a Documentation Engineering Manager to lead this work. This is a hands-on player-coach role for someone who can lead a small, highly technical team while contributing directly to both technical documentation and the engineering of the documentation website and its supporting infrastructure.
What you’ll do
Lead the execution, development, and prioritization of the Docs Engineering team while remaining hands-on in both technical writing and engineering.
Own the reliability, availability, performance, and technical evolution of the ClickHouse documentation website, treating it as a critical part of the product experience.
Research, develop, and write technical documentation directly, including independently understanding product functionality through source code, experimentation, testing, and collaboration with Engineering and Product, rather than relying on others to provide initial drafts.
Define and execute documentation strategy in partnership with Engineering, Product, Product Marketing, Learning, Support, Growth, and the open-source community.
Improve docs-as-code contribution workflows so that engineers, product managers, the Docs team, and external contributors can create and maintain excellent documentation efficiently.

Work directly with teams across ClickHouse to understand their needs, translate them into practical documentation processes, coach authors, and resolve competing priorities.
Ensure documentation remains accurate, comprehensive, discoverable, and aligned with the pace of product development.
Make documentation a driver of product adoption and growth, helping users discover ClickHouse, get started quickly, and convert into active users through an intuitive, frictionless documentation experience.
What we’re looking for
Prior experience managing and developing a technical team.
A hands-on leader who is comfortable moving between people management, technical writing, software engineering, process design, and day-to-day execution.

We are looking for a Senior Partner Solutions Architect to lead technical engagement with independent software vendors (ISVs) and strategic technology partners. You will help partners build, embed, deploy, validate, and go to market with MongoDB-based solutions that create repeatable customer value and accelerate MongoDB adoption.
This role combines enterprise architecture, partner engineering, technical pre-sales, solution assurance, and go-to-market enablement. You will work across the complete partner lifecycle—from opportunity discovery and business-value alignment through architecture, validation, design wins, launch readiness, and post-launch reuse.
You will be successful in this role if you can move fluidly between a partner’s product architecture, a customer’s business problem, MongoDB’s technical capabilities, and the field motion needed to scale the outcome.

Serve as the senior technical advisor for strategic ISV and technology-partner engagements, including embedded software, SaaS, BYOA/BYO-EA, AI, and agent products
Lead technical discovery and architecture reviews that clarify the partner’s workload, adoption path, deployment model, customer segment, success criteria, and MongoDB value proposition

Establish evidence-based readiness gates and partner maturity assessments; distinguish clearly between tested, supported, recommended, and go-to-market-approved claims
Design reference architectures, integration patterns, sizing guidance, deployment blueprints, quickstarts, demos, troubleshooting guidance, and partner-facing documentation

Deliver technical workshops, webinars, executive briefings, partner enablement, and customer-facing presentations that turn validated architecture into pipeline and adoption
Build scalable operating mechanisms for ISV onboarding, intake, partner classification, evidence collection, gap remediation, conflict management, approval workflows, and post-launch re-assurance
Turn individual engagements into reusable assets and operating patterns that improve time to value, partner self-service, field readiness, technical quality, and customer success
Represent partner requirements internally, influence product and roadmap decisions, and escalate technical or business dependencies that could affect partner launch timing or customer outcomes

Experience reviewing or designing production architectures for SaaS, embedded software, AI/agent applications, or customer-managed deployments

Experience with public cloud platforms and/or self-managed environments; Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, identity, OAuth, and cloud-native operations are valuable
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear architecture decisions, executive-level recommendations, partner messaging, and field enablement
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, whiteboarding, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills
Ability to operate independently in ambiguous, cross-functional environments and create structure where partner processes are still evolving

Nice to have
Experience with MongoDB Atlas, MongoDB Enterprise Advanced, MongoDB Search, Vector Search, or MongoDB partner integrations
Experience establishing technical validation, Well-Architected Framework, solution-assurance, certification, or partner self-attestation programs
Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture, embedded databases, OEM offerings, DBaaS, or sovereign-cloud solutions

Experience with performance benchmarking, reference implementations, technical workshops, field enablement, or partner launch programs

job.title: Head of Competitive Intelligence
job.description_text:
Datadog is building a product-led Competitive Intelligence function to help inform product strategy, roadmap prioritization, positioning, and competitive readiness.
As the Head of Competitive Intelligence you will build and lead the CompIntel function across priority competitors and adjacent market opportunities. You will translate competitor product evolution, technical capabilities, launches, pricing value, customer sentiment, analyst narratives, and ecosystem shifts into actionable insights for Product, GTM, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Technical Advocacy, and leadership.
In this highly technical, hands-on leadership role, you should understand how observability products are implemented, where workflows differ, what technical claims are credible, and how product gaps translate into customer impact.
At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.
What You'll Do:
Own the recurring competitive radar for Datadog’s priority competitor set, including taxonomy, source standards, evidence quality, and update cadence.
Produce competitive deep dives, feature-gap analyses, early-warning briefs, and opportunity assessments tied to specific product domains and leadership questions.
Translate CompIntel findings into roadmap recommendations, product differentiation hypotheses, and Product-facing decision guidance.
Build and maintain a central CompIntel repository with competitor profiles, source notes, comparison frameworks, evidence logs, and decision-ready briefs.
Convert validated findings into GTM-ready handoffs for battlecards, objection handling, strategic deal narratives, and field enablement.
Synthesize signals from Product, Engineering, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, field teams, technical communities, Advocacy programs, win/loss, customer feedback, analyst research, public competitor materials, and CABs.
Partner with Product Management to frame competitive questions, identify decision criteria, and connect findings to roadmap and prioritization discussions.
Partner with Technical Advocacy to incorporate practitioner, customer, technical-market, community, event, and CAB signal into competitive analysis.
Present concise, credible recommendations to Product leadership and Product + GTM forums.
Maintain source transparency, legal compliance, ethical research practices, and auditable methods across competitive research workflows.
Lead a small, high-impact team of CompIntel analysts and engineers.
Who You Are:
You have 8+ years of experience in competitive intelligence, technical product strategy, product management, market intelligence, strategic technical research, or related enterprise software work.
You have strong technical fluency in one or more of the following areas: observability, cloud infrastructure, security, developer tooling, distributed systems or enterprise SaaS platforms.
You are comfortable reading technical documentation, changelogs, release notes, architecture diagrams, product announcements, and public competitor materials.
You can distinguish credible technical differentiation from surface-level claims.
You can synthesize technical, commercial, customer, and market evidence into clear recommendations.
You have strong executive writing skills and can produce concise memos, structured briefs, comparison frameworks, and leadership-ready recommendations.
You can influence Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and leadership stakeholders without direct authority.
You are comfortable working in ambiguous environments where the function, taxonomy, operating cadence, and stakeholder model need to be built from the ground up.
You understand legal, ethical, and compliance considerations in competitive intelligence gathering.
Bonus Points:
Experience in observability, cloud infrastructure, security, developer tooling, platform engineering, or technical enterprise SaaS.
Experience supporting Product Management or product strategy through technical analysis, roadmap inputs, customer evidence, or market intelligence.
Experience building a competitive intelligence program, research repository, competitor taxonomy, or recurring market-monitoring process.
Familiarity with SCIP ethics guidance, evidence governance, source transparency, and legally approved research methods.
Experience translating technical findings into GTM-ready enablement materials without overstating claims.

job.title: Principal Software Engineer (Java) - Security - Elasticsearch
job.description_text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
We are seeking a Principal Software Developer to join the Elasticsearch Security team. In this role, you will lead the architecture and design of Elasticsearch's main features. These features include authentication, authorization, and tenant isolation.
You will work with engineering and product leaders at Elastic. Your goal is to provide high-performance security at all levels. This includes ensuring that our distributed data store has top-quality security at scale.
What You Will Be Doing
Owning core security initiatives from architecture to production, focusing on the delivery of new critical features. Leading the technical design, plan, and execution for major security components inside the Elasticsearch core engine.
Developing the foundational security models for intricate features.
Optimizing security performance at scale in distributed systems environments.
Applying cryptographic solutions to address genuine customer use cases.
Ensuring robust data isolation within shared infrastructure supporting disparate customers.
Monitoring and applying the latest advancements and best practices in security. This includes authentication, identity management, cryptography, and data access management.
Collaborating with peers across the company to embed security into new customer features from the outset.
Drive vulnerability management efforts by collaborating closely with the InfoSec team to proactively identify, assess, and remediate security risks.
Leverage AI-driven tools to automate vulnerability triage, prioritization, and preliminary investigation, streamlining security workflows and reducing manual intervention.
Mentoring and coaching other engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and security-first development.
What You Bring
You have deep knowledge of Java internals and JVM memory management. You understand how concurrency models work. You can write code that is high-performance, thread-safe, and lock-free. This experience includes working with large open-source and enterprise codebases.
You have proven experience in designing and building systems for authorization that can scale. This includes deep experience designing scalable RBAC/ABAC models and token validation pipelines. It includes permission compilation and distributed cache invalidation strategies.
You have a solid comprehension of distributed systems security, including node-to-node mutual trust, zero-trust transport, partition tolerance, and cluster state propagation.
You have a deep knowledge of edge identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML).
You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
You can work autonomously, drive decisions, and lead a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.
Bonus Points
Knowledge of cipher suites, TLS handshakes, and PKI/certificate lifecycle management.
Cryptographic methods considering memory usage and delays.
Familiarity with the implications of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) and readiness to support the migration of services to quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms.
Hands-on experience mapping engine-level technical controls to FedRAMP (Moderate/High), FIPS 140, and SOC 2 requirements.
Experience working on the internals of a data store or search engine.
Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

job.title: Principal Software Engineer, Security
job.description_text:
MongoDB's Global Security Organization (GSO) is looking for a Principal Engineer. The GSO secures MongoDB's products, infrastructure, and the trust our customers place in us — spanning product security, corporate security, and risk, and working across engineering, go-to-market, and corporate development to keep security moving at the same speed as the business.
The Principal Engineer will serve as a senior technical anchor for the team. This is a deep individual-contributor role that will stay hands-on with hard security and architecture problems, form sharp independent opinions, and know how to debate, align, and commit once GSO has made a call.
Key topic areas will include collaborating with our product teams to ensure identity and permission models meet customer needs for our new autonomous agent platform and working with integration security teams to push the envelope on automated detection, reproduction, and remediation of security vulnerabilities via AI. What we need here is depth, judgment, and the ability to build up the bench of senior technical talent around you.
This role can be based out of our NYC office or remotely in the North America region.
Responsibilities
Maintain real technical depth in security and in MongoDB's product architecture — compute, network, and storage — deep enough to evaluate actual risk rather than apply generic best practice.
Form independent, well-reasoned opinions on security and architecture decisions, and voice them even when they cut against consensus or a leader's default plan.
Push teams to move faster when process or over-engineering is introducing complexity without reducing risk — and push teams to slow down when GTM pressure is outrunning a clear-eyed view of the risk.
Debate hard, then align, then commit: help the org land on the right call, then execute on it.
Seed and grow a working community of senior ICs embedded in security operations, product security, and enterprise security — connecting people, sharing knowledge, and creating the venues (formal or informal) for that to happen.
Lead time-boxed, high-stakes, cross-functional engagements such as M&A security due diligence and partner risk assessments, often with incomplete information and a short runway.
Draw on your own expertise where it applies, and quickly figure out how to close knowledge gaps elsewhere — staying accountable for the outcome either way.
Requirements
12+ years of experience in security engineering, software engineering, or a related discipline, including senior individual-contributor or technical-lead experience.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Deep, credible technical expertise in security, plus working depth across compute, network, and storage architecture.
A track record of forming and defending independent technical positions, along with the judgment to know when to stop debating and commit.
Experience influencing without formal authority, including with management and cross-functional partners, in both directions — accelerating and slowing down decisions.
Comfort owning ambiguous, deadline-driven work such as M&A diligence or partner risk reviews, and being accountable for the result even without the full picture upfront.
A genuine interest in mentoring and connecting other senior engineers, without needing a management title to do it.
Don't feel that you meet all of the requirements? We encourage you to apply anyway — studies show strong candidates sometimes rule themselves out prematurely. MongoDB has a diverse, inclusive, equitable, and high-performing environment, and we want to keep improving our ability to deliver for customers.
Nice to Haves
Direct experience leading M&A security due diligence or partner/vendor risk assessments.
Background spanning multiple layers of the stack (e.g., network and storage, or application and infrastructure security).
A history of building or growing technical communities of practice.
Success in This Role Means
Leadership trusts your technical judgment on the hardest, most ambiguous calls.
Your willingness to disagree — in either direction, faster or slower — makes decisions better, not just louder.
A real community of senior security talent has formed around you in GSO.
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. job.description_text:
InfraSec operates on a preventative, enabling model: rather than acting as a manual approval gatekeeper or compliance auditor, we develop automated guardrails and platform capabilities. We integrate security directly into the platform runtime, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) workflows so engineering teams can operate securely at scale without friction.
This role can be based out of our office or remotely in the United States.
What You’ll Do

Secure containerized infrastructure across multi-cloud environments via RBAC, network policies, admission controls (Gatekeeper), and runtime threat detection
Build and manage automated services for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), workload identity, vulnerability management, and access controls across AWS, Azure, and GCP
Write production-quality code and leverage Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) to version, test, and deploy security controls as code
Build real-time security monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to detect anomalies and track security posture at Atlas scale
Lead initiatives across their full lifecycle; from threat modeling and architectural design to implementation, rollout, and long-term production reliability
What We’re Looking For
Minimum Qualifications:
10+ years in SRE, Infrastructure Engineering, or Cloud Security Engineering
A track record of operating at Staff or Principal scope: defining technical direction, resolving cross-team ambiguity, and personally championing initiatives from conception to delivery
Strong coding skills in Go (Golang), Python, C, C++, or Rust
Proven track record of building and operating large-scale distributed systems or cloud platform infrastructure
Hands-on experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible for automated infrastructure provisioning
Demonstrated experience owning infrastructure in Linux, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Preferred Qualifications:
Practical experience with eBPF-based security tooling (Cilium, Falco, Tetragon)
Direct ownership of Cloud Security and Workload Identity platforms
Multi-cloud expertise spanning AWS, Azure, and GCP
Production exposure to low-level Linux security mechanisms (seccomp, AppArmor, SELinux, cgroups)

job.description_text:
Salesforce Solutions Consultant
Solutions | United States (Remote) | Full-Time | NAM
Who We Are
Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. At BPX, we hire operators and specialists who thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical execution.
What We Do
We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.
The Role
You'll be the person prospects watch when they want to see Salesforce solve their problem in a live org. In this presales seat you design, build and deliver tailored demonstrations across the Salesforce Core platform, turning what you learn in discovery into a working story inside a live org. A typical week mixes discovery calls, demo builds, RFP responses and deal strategy sessions with our Account Executives. You'll field the hard product, architecture and integration questions in the room, then work with our delivery team so what gets sold is scoped to land. It's a hands-on role for someone who would rather configure the product than talk about it, with occasional travel for customer meetings, demos and team events.
What you'll do
Build tailored demos end to end, mapped to each prospect's own requirements and use cases.
Own the demo orgs, keeping environments, sample data and reusable scenarios current and presentation-ready.
Lead discovery sessions that surface business pain, technical requirements and success criteria, then shape the solution story.
Partner with Account Executives on solution strategy, value positioning and technical objections through the sales cycle.
Answer RFPs and RFIs and technical questionnaires, and support proof-of-concept and pilot engagements.
Keep proposals realistic with delivery and product teams, so every solution is scoped accurately and set up to implement well.
Bring new releases into your demos as the Salesforce roadmap moves, especially Agentforce and Data Cloud.
What you'll bring
Hands-on Salesforce depth: 5 to 7 years configuring, building and demonstrating on the platform.
Presales experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Consultant or Presales Consultant, or in a demo-focused role.
Multi-cloud range to demo Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud (Data 360), Experience Cloud and Agentforce with confidence.
Consultative discovery skills that connect a business problem to the right platform capability.
Presence in the room to tell a clear story, run a live demo and handle technical questions on the spot.
Self-directed remote working, comfortable running your own week across a fully distributed team.
Bonus points for Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Sales, Service or Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist) or partner and SI experience.
Why this role, why now
Salesforce clients want to see Agentforce and Data Cloud working against their own use cases before they commit. As a Salesforce Summit Partner growing on private equity backing, BPX gives you the platform breadth and the customer conversations to show them, across Sales, Service, Data and Experience Cloud.

job.title: Senior Solutions Engineer | Switzerland | Remote
job.description_text:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Solutions Engineering team are the customer facing product experts. The team enables Grafana Labs worldwide growth by educating potential and existing customers to ensure that they are happy and successful. We share our technical and product expertise with customers through demos, hands on enablement, presentations, technical evaluations and ongoing interaction. We partner closely with our Sales team to help qualify and close opportunities. The Solutions Engineering team is one of the primary routes of communication from our customers to the Product Management and Engineering teams.
A Solutions Engineer is able to really listen to a prospect or customer, understand their requirements, ask the right questions to extract as much information as required and translate all that into a solution with Grafana Labs technology. They are the bridge between the highly technical engineering folks here at Grafana Labs, our customers and our Sales team.
What You'll Be Doing
Partnering with our Sales team to articulate the overall Grafana value proposition, vision and strategy to customers
Owning the technical engagement with customers and help close complex opportunities through advanced competitive knowledge, technical skill and credibility
Delivering product and technical presentations to potential and existing customers
Effectively communicate with customers and internal teams to provide feedback on our products and the competitive landscape
Driving product conversations based on need and problems with customers
Working with the team to enhance documentation, write blog posts, record videos, contribute knowledge base articles and create other public or private enablement material
What Makes you a Great Fit:
5+ years of technical pre-sales experience
Be open to various and complex assignments, this will require strong judgment, collaboration, and leadership
You will need first class written and oral communication skills to collaborate with our remote-first internal teams and with our worldwide customers. You will need to be able to skillfully articulate our value proposition and the technical advantages of our products
You love solving technical challenges and thrive on bringing creative solutions to our customers
You should have a technical mindset and a desire to grow technically.
Must be located in Switzerland

Experience with Open Source technologies, or in the Metrics/Monitoring space is an advantage
Experience with sales methodologies like MEDD(P)ICC is a plus

100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

job.title: Engineering Manager, Metadata
job.description_text:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
About the Role
Fivetran and dbt Labs are building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. We're looking for an engineering manager to lead our Metadata team, which owns the metadata layer of the dbt platform: the discovery API, catalog, lineage, and run history services that let customers understand, trust, and act on what their data is doing.
You'll own technical excellence and delivery of a single team, from evolving high-throughput APIs and data models, to hardening reliability and latency for enterprise and single-tenant customers, to shipping new discovery and catalog capabilities in close partnership with product. You'll set direction, review designs and code, remove roadblocks, and grow the engineers on your team through coaching, feedback, and clear career development.
What You'll Do
Lead and grow a team of software engineers, owning hiring, onboarding, coaching, career development plans, and regular 1:1s and check-ins
Own project delivery for your team against the quarterly plan, and be accountable for the reliability and performance of the services you own (e.g. uptime and latency targets)
Review technical designs and code, and provide feedback grounded in a deep understanding of the Metadata product area and architecture
Drive the team to address technical quality — incidents, bugs, tech debt, and post-mortems — within SLA and metric targets
Partner with product and business stakeholders on planning, and maintain a realistic, prioritized feature and project backlog with a high completion rate
Contextualize and communicate the engineering vision and strategy to your team, and share the team's work and business impact with adjacent teams
Ensure engineering processes (e.g. FDLC) are implemented and consistently followed
Delegate effectively and build autonomy and a positive, high-trust culture within the team
Address performance issues and conflict promptly and fairly
Ensure your team uses AI tooling — IDE assistants like GitHub Copilot, coding agents like Claude Code, and conversational AI — to accelerate development and to author and review SDLC artifacts such as TDDs, PRDs, post-mortems, and test plans
Skills We're Looking For
Experience managing and growing a software engineering team (ideally a customer-facing product development team); including hiring, coaching, and running a full performance and career-development cycle
Strong technical foundation with the ability to review designs and code and make sound architectural trade-offs in a distributed, cloud-based systems environment
Track record of delivering complex projects on schedule while holding the team to high standards of quality, reliability, and performance
Experience owning production services and driving operational health — incident response, on-call practices, tech-debt reduction, and meeting SLAs
Ability to plan and prioritize with product partners, maintain a realistic backlog, and drive high sprint and quarterly completion rates
Communicates clearly and effectively across the team and with adjacent teams and stakeholders; keeps people well informed
Fluent in using AI code assistants, coding agents, and conversational AI (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) to support the software development lifecycle, and able to establish those practices across a team
Bonus Skills
Experience building or operating metadata, catalog, lineage, or discovery/search systems
Experience with GraphQL APIs and high-throughput, multi-tenant data services
Familiarity with the analytics engineering workflow and the dbt ecosystem
Experience supporting enterprise or single-tenant customers with strict reliability and latency requirements

As the Director of Dedicated Infrastructure Engineering & Platforms, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for GitLab Dedicated, GitLab's premium single-tenant SaaS offering for enterprise customers in regulated industries, and public sector.
You will lead a high-performing organization of managers and engineers who own the entire lifecycle of dedicated and cellular platforms, from orchestration, integrations, resilience, and incident response to switchboard APIs, public sector compliance, and enterprise customer migrations. Your mission is to scale GitLab Dedicated from its current trajectory toward an aggressive growth target, ensuring enterprise customers experience full platform capabilities with dedicated infrastructure, compliance certifications, and enterprise-grade SLAs in an isolated environment.
As a high-impact executive leader, you will define the strategy for single-tenant and public sector SaaS platforms, drive critical infrastructure investments, ensure FedRAMP/compliance operational readiness, and build the switchboard and migration capabilities that allow enterprise customers to seamlessly transition to and scale on Dedicated. You will succeed by cultivating a culture of operational excellence, closing key business and roadmap gaps, and leading distributed engineering teams to deliver high-availability, highly secure platform experiences.
What you'll do
Own the strategy and roadmap for GitLab Dedicated, and ensure the platform scales with customer growth and converges with GitLab's cellular architecture.
Partner with Product and executive leadership to deliver on growth targets, with a focus on platform reliability, faster customer onboarding, infrastructure cost efficiency, and self-service administration.
Lead the engineering teams that build and run the platform: tenant orchestration and integrations, resilience and incident response, the Switchboard control plane, public sector platforms and compliance, and enterprise migrations and import tooling. Uphold enterprise-grade SLAs across every tenant.
Deliver GitLab Dedicated for Government: AWS GovCloud infrastructure, FedRAMP operations and audit readiness, air-gapped isolation, and public sector feature delivery.
Make enterprise migrations to Dedicated predictable, repeatable, and low-disruption through self-service tooling and guided workflows.
Hire, coach, and scale engineering managers across distributed teams, and bring practical AI-enabled workflows into how the organization works.
Partner with Product, Security, and Customer Support to keep customer commitments, architecture, and investments aligned.
Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
What you'll bring
You have led engineering organizations that run enterprise single or multi tenant SaaS infrastructure and cloud platforms at scale.
You have measurably improved production reliability, reduced toil, or lowered infrastructure cost on a platform you owned.
You have deep expertise in cloud-native and cellular architectures, Infrastructure as Code, and modular services that deploy and scale independently across cloud environments.
You have delivered and operated enterprise offerings under strict compliance regimes such as FedRAMP and AWS GovCloud.
You have led organizational changes, including adopting AI enabled workflows that raise engineering system efficiencies.
You translate financial targets into engineering investments, headcount plans, and execution roadmaps.
You lead with ownership, speed with quality, and a focus on customer outcomes.
About the team
The Dedicated Infrastructure & Platforms organization builds and runs GitLab Dedicated, our single-tenant enterprise SaaS offering, for GitLab's most strategic enterprise and public sector accounts. It is organized into five focus areas:
Platform Orchestration & Integrations: orchestration, deployment, and environment automation for Dedicated tenants and cellular environments, plus integrations with external products.
Core Features, Resilience & Response: compliance and operations driven features, disaster recovery, automated failover, rate limiting, and incident response automation.
Switchboard & Control Plane: the APIs, tenant change automation, and operator and customer interfaces that make Dedicated self-service.
Public Sector Platforms & Compliance: AWS GovCloud infrastructure, FedRAMP compliance operations, air-gapped isolation, and Geo replication for GitLab Dedicated for Government.
Enterprise Migrations & Import Tooling: customer migration programs and playbooks, Geo-based migration tooling, Direct Transfer, and self-service guided import workflows.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both strategic problem solving and hands-on program execution, can translate complex compensation concepts into simple experiences for managers and employees, and thrives in a highly cross-functional environment.

job.title: Manager, Sales Engineering Specialists
job.description_text:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
About the Role
Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.
We’re looking for a Manager Sales Engineering Specialists to oversee our data platform Specialists functions. In this role, you will work alongside global Sales Engineering leadership to leverage a team of technical experts to accelerate our most complex enterprise deals, drive customer adoption after the sale, and improve the efficiency of the Sales Engineering motion at large. As customers build toward AI and agentic workloads, you will keep your team ahead of what those workloads demand of the data platform.
You will need a deep understanding of how modern data movement and transformation platforms like ours are architected, including the AI use cases built on top of them, and a keen ability to lead a team of highly specialized resources. You will be tasked with developing and retaining experienced, high-performing talent who can speak the language of enterprise architects, data engineers, and data platform owners, and with hiring where the team needs to grow.
This is a full-time position based in the US.
Technologies You’ll Use
Fivetran, dbt, Enterprise databases and applications (including SAP), cloud data warehouses and lakehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks), open table formats (Apache Iceberg), dbt, SQL, reverse ETL, AI and agent tooling, AWS, GCP, Azure
What You’ll Do
Lead a team of tenured experts across our data platform specialties to act as technical liaisons between Sales Engineering, Sales, Product, and Engineering.
Support Global Sales teams by proactively embedding specialist functions to remove technical blockers in complex enterprise deals and in customer adoption after the sale.
Implement strategies to maximize deal velocity and customer adoption by streamlining how specialists are engaged, prioritized, and measured.
Execute hands-on tasks when needed, including architecture reviews, critical customer calls, or complex proofs of value.
Ensure the team provides timely, strategic, and accurate guidance during technical evaluations and customer escalations.
Build strong working relationships with strategic internal partners, including Product, Engineering, and other sales teams.
Coach team members to maximize performance and efficiency, and prepare them for future roles.
Ensure the team shares specialist knowledge across the field through enablement and documentation.
Keep the team current on how AI and agentic workloads change customer requirements, and turn that into field guidance.
Skills We’re Looking For
People Leadership: Proven experience leading and developing a Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or other technical team, with people management experience preferred.
Technical Depth: Hands-on expertise in one or more areas across the data lifecycle, such as database and application replication, SAP, lake and warehouse architectures, transformation, activation, or AI and context engineering, and the breadth to credibly lead specialists in other disciplines. Experience applying a narrower specialty across several of these areas also counts.
Cloud and Data Architecture: Proficiency with major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), specifically regarding deployment and connectivity, and with modern data architectures, including cloud data warehouses and lakehouses.
AI Fluency: Working understanding of how AI and agentic workloads change customers' data requirements, and fluency using AI tools to scale your own and your team's work.
Technical Sales Acumen: Extensive Sales Engineering or specialist experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles, including proofs of value and senior stakeholders, and deep knowledge of the broader technical sales and demonstration process.
Communication Skills: Best-in-class ability to explain complex data and AI concepts to non-technical buyers and technical architects alike, and to influence Product and Engineering priorities with customer evidence.
Bonus Skills​
Prior experience at an analytics, ETL, BI, or open-source data software company
Familiarity with dbt, Terraform, or similar tools for transformation and managing cloud infrastructure
Experience managing distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones
Hands-on experience with AI and context engineering, such as LLM applications, MCP, semantic layers, or metadata and retrieval

$212,004.29—$294,450.54 USD
Perks and Benefits
100% employer-paid medical insurance*
Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
RSU stock grants*
Professional development and training opportunities
Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
Monthly cell phone stipend
Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

job.title: Principal Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
job.description_text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What Is The Role:
We are on the lookout for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.
What You Will Be Doing:
Leveraging your deep distributed systems expertise to design, build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.
What You Bring:
You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.
You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
You have experience building large-scale distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
You have experience building and debugging complex features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
You have experience managing projects involving multiple engineers.
You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.
