Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla.
We're on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!
We're looking for a Senior Revenue Accountant to join our revenue accounting team. You will report to the Director of Order to Cash and Revenue Accounting and be responsible for executing the month-end close cycle for revenue recognition, including reconciliations for revenue and deferred revenue, reviewing customer contracts, and preparing financial reporting metrics such as RPO. You'll work cross-functionally with AR & Billing, Legal, Sales Operations, FP&A, and Data teams to build scalable, automated revenue processes.
You Will
Own the end-to-end monthly revenue close, preparing journal entries, reconciliations, and flux analyses for revenue, deferred revenue, and contract asset balances.
Prepare the deferred revenue waterfall and financial reporting metrics.
Reconcile consumption data to billing and revenue; use SQL/data queries and AI tools to assist and automate the work.
Review customer contracts and order forms under ASC 606, and prepare accounting checklist for complex or non-standard deals.
Prepare estimate calculations, including the standalone selling price (SSP) analyses.
Support new product introductions (NPI), new pricing models, SKU launches, and system upgrades or implementations.
Support external audits and manage PBC requests related to revenue.
Collaborate cross-functionally with AR & Billing, Legal, Sales Operations, FP&A, and Data teams to improve the quote-to-revenue workflow.
You Bring
3+ years of progressive accounting experience with a focus on revenue accounting, ideally at a SaaS or consumption-based technology company.
Strong working knowledge of ASC 606, including contract review, SSP, and revenue disclosures (deferred revenue, RPO).
Experience with NetSuite, Stripe, and Salesforce, and familiarity with the integrations and data flows among these systems; experience with cloud marketplace billing (AWS, GCP, Azure) is a plus.
Comfort working with large data sets; SQL or similar query skills, and an interest in using AI and automation to streamline processes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex contracts and data sets.
A quick learner with excellent attention to detail, organization, and communication skills; able to collaborate cross-functionally and explain revenue matters clearly.
CPA (or equivalent) and/or Big Four public accounting experience preferred.
Experience supporting audits, internal controls, and SOX readiness preferred.
Perks
Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.
Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.
Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.
Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.
A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.
Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.
Culture - We All Shape It
As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.
Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

job.title: Mid-Market Implementation Specialist - Americas
job.description_text:
Mid-Market Implementation Specialist
Hi! I'm Daryl, and I'm the Manager of High Touch (Mid-Market) Implementations at Ashby. One of my favorite things about this team is that we're the first real proof point for a new customer; from day 1, we get the hands-on opportunity to show them why they made the right call switching to Ashby.
The Ashby team has grown rapidly over the last few years, and we're not slowing down: we added more than 2,100 new customers in the last year alone and now support over 5,000 customers, with ARR growing much faster than 100% year over year. We're expecting similarly fast growth this year, and every one of those new customers needs a thoughtful implementation to actually get value out of Ashby. We'll share more details once we meet, but you probably have a good idea as to why we're expanding this team!
The Role:
We're looking for a Mid-Market Implementation Specialist who excels at leading technically complex, hands on implementation projects for B2B SaaS customers. You'll own each implementation from the moment Sales hands it off through go-live; part project manager, part technical expert, and part trusted advisor to the customer!
Six months in, success looks like carrying a full book of 15-20 active implementations, running each customer relationship on your own (kickoff, timeline, follow-through), independently solving complex configuration and workflow challenges, and handling the normal bumps (a slow-to-respond customer, a technical snag, an escalation) without the rest of your book slipping. It also means you're starting to make things better beyond your own accounts: you've found at least one process or documentation gap and fixed it, and you're feeding real customer feedback back to our Product team.
You will achieve this by:
Managing 15-20 active mid-market implementations at a time (8-10 weeks implementation timeline on average), building each customer's project plan from handoff through go-live, and staying on top of timelines, hurdles, and follow-up along the way
Getting genuinely comfortable with the in’s and out’s of how our products work, so you can troubleshoot and advise instead of just walking through a checklist
Advising on what’s worked well for similar customers in the past, challenging assumptions when appropriate, and recommending configurations and workflows that balance customer needs with implementation best practices
Partnering closely with cross-functional partners across the business, especially Sales and CS to ensure a seamless customer journey, and Product/Engineering to flag real issues and align on a path forward
As you're probably gathering, we're looking for someone who gets energy from both sides of this: the structure of running a tight project plan, and the judgment to rethink that plan when a customer's business genuinely calls for it.
If you have the majority of the following, you could be a great fit for this role:
5+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, with the majority of your focus on leading full-cycle B2B SaaS implementations
Proven track record successfully managing concurrent mid-market implementation projects without compromising quality, customer experience, or timelines
Experience operating with real autonomy and to own the implementation project plans end-to-end
Comfortable getting into the weeds of complex, multi-module software, and building genuine fluency in how it all fits together
Resourceful when there's no documented answer; you do your own testing and discovery, then use what you learn to advise customers on best practices and recommendations
Data-driven and detail-oriented, with a genuine instinct for coaching customers through unfamiliar territory
If you need someone else to do any of the following, then this role is probably not for you:
Independently investigate complex customer questions and become the technical/product subject matter expert during implementations
Carry more than a handful of accounts at once (this is a high volume role on a team that moves with urgency)
Own the execution of a project plan, not just its design
Iterate and improve on existing processes
About Ashby
We’re building the next generation of enterprise software, and we’re starting with a suite of products that help talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. Learn more on our website: https://www.ashbyhq.com/
We are well funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom. We have thousands of amazing customers including Snowflake, OpenAI, Shopify, Ramp, Notion, and Zapier (and many others who we cannot name!). Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet. In short, it's the perfect time to join! 🚀
Instructions
Please take your time with your application and the application questions. Although we use AI to assist in our review, we never use AI to auto-qualify or disqualify candidates. We lay eyes on each and every application, and speak to a very select number of candidates based on the application as a whole. This is an evergreen opening, so there is no need to rush, and there are no prizes for being first!
Our Philosophy
Here are a few key points (relevant to the go-to-market side) that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:
We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is a lot easier to sell.
We want to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.
We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people (and the right work environment) deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We hire and compensate accordingly.
We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Operating Principles to get a sense of what we are looking for in folks on the team.
The Interview
At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. Our interview process is structured to get to know you and your career as well as empower you with insight into our key focus areas. Here is the process in its entirety:
30 min - Recruiter Screen with Talent Team
45 min - Interview with Manager of High Touch Implementations
60 min- Mock Call with an Implementation Specialist and Customer Success Manager
Final Round:
30 min - Cross-Functional Interview with Head of Professional Services
30 min - Product Complexity Interview with VP of Customer Success
30 min - Customer Adoption & Enablement with Manager of High Touch Customer Success and a High Touch Customer Success Manager
10 min - Closing Questions with Hiring Manager
Benefits
You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.
You get to sell a product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about.
Competitive compensation is offered.
10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
Unlimited PTO with four weeks is recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅
Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.
Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. You'll own each implementation from the moment Sales hands it off through go-live; part project manager, part technical expert, and part trusted advisor to the customer!
Six months in, success looks like carrying a full book of 15-20 active implementations, running each customer relationship on your own (kickoff, timeline, follow-through), independently solving complex configuration and workflow challenges, and handling the normal bumps (a slow-to-respond customer, a technical snag, an escalation) without the rest of your book slipping. It also means you're starting to make things better beyond your own accounts: you've found at least one process or documentation gap and fixed it, and you're feeding real customer feedback back to our Product team.
You will achieve this by:
Managing 15-20 active mid-market implementations at a time (8-10 weeks implementation timeline on average), building each customer's project plan from handoff through go-live, and staying on top of timelines, hurdles, and follow-up along the way
Getting genuinely comfortable with the in’s and out’s of how our products work, so you can troubleshoot and advise instead of just walking through a checklist
Advising on what’s worked well for similar customers in the past, challenging assumptions when appropriate, and recommending configurations and workflows that balance customer needs with implementation best practices
Partnering closely with cross-functional partners across the business, especially Sales and CS to ensure a seamless customer journey, and Product/Engineering to flag real issues and align on a path forward
As you're probably gathering, we're looking for someone who gets energy from both sides of this: the structure of running a tight project plan, and the judgment to rethink that plan when a customer's business genuinely calls for it.
If you have the majority of the following, you could be a great fit for this role:
5+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, with the majority of your focus on leading full-cycle B2B SaaS implementations
Proven track record successfully managing concurrent mid-market implementation projects without compromising quality, customer experience, or timelines
Experience operating with real autonomy and to own the implementation project plans end-to-end
Comfortable getting into the weeds of complex, multi-module software, and building genuine fluency in how it all fits together
Resourceful when there's no documented answer; you do your own testing and discovery, then use what you learn to advise customers on best practices and recommendations
Data-driven and detail-oriented, with a genuine instinct for coaching customers through unfamiliar territory
If you need someone else to do any of the following, then this role is probably not for you:
Independently investigate complex customer questions and become the technical/product subject matter expert during implementations
Carry more than a handful of accounts at once (this is a high volume role on a team that moves with urgency)
Own the execution of a project plan, not just its design
Iterate and improve on existing processes
About Ashby
We’re building the next generation of enterprise software, and we’re starting with a suite of products that help talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. Learn more on our website: https://www.ashbyhq.com/
We are well funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom. We have thousands of amazing customers including Snowflake, OpenAI, Shopify, Ramp, Notion, and Zapier (and many others who we cannot name!). Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet. In short, it's the perfect time to join! 🚀
Instructions
Please take your time with your application and the application questions. Although we use AI to assist in our review, we never use AI to auto-qualify or disqualify candidates. We lay eyes on each and every application, and speak to a very select number of candidates based on the application as a whole. This is an evergreen opening, so there is no need to rush, and there are no prizes for being first!
Our Philosophy
Here are a few key points (relevant to the go-to-market side) that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:
We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is a lot easier to sell.
We want to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.
We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people (and the right work environment) deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We hire and compensate accordingly.
We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Operating Principles to get a sense of what we are looking for in folks on the team.
The Interview
At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. Our interview process is structured to get to know you and your career as well as empower you with insight into our key focus areas. Here is the process in its entirety:
30 min - Recruiter Screen with Talent Team
45 min - Interview with the Manager, of High Touch Implementations
60 min- Mock Call with Strategic Implementation Specialist and High Touch Implementation Specialist
Final Round:
30 min - Cross-Functional Interview with Head of Professional Services
30 min - Product Complexity Interview with VP of Customer Success
30 min - Customer Adoption & Enablement with Manager of High Touch Customer Success and a High Touch Customer Success Manager
10 min - Closing Questions with Hiring Manager
Benefits
You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.
You get to sell a product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about.
Competitive compensation is offered.
10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
Unlimited PTO with four weeks is recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval

job.description_text:
Spotify's in-house creative studio, Reverb, brings our brand to life through thoughtful design, visual storytelling, and creative production. Working across brand and communications, the team creates work that connects with audiences around the world.
We're looking for a Global Creative Lead to shape the visual direction of Reverb and lead a talented team of graphic designers, motion designers, and producers. Partner with teams across brand, communications, marketing, and production to turn creative briefs into engaging visual experiences across channels and formats.

Who You Are

job.title: Research Scientist - Generative Audio
job.description_text:
We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab. Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:
Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.
Learn more in our press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/
What You'll Do
Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas:
Vocal Synthesis — Research in vocal and speech synthesis, along with related areas such as ML-based audio processing and signal processing.
Post-Training — Research in post-training techniques for music generation, including preference alignment methods (such as DPO, RLHF, or KTO), reward model design and training, and reinforcement learning to improve output quality, controllability, and human preference adherence.
Editing — Research in iterative music generation and audio editing, including capabilities such as stem replacement, instrumentation change, mood changes (while preserving content), tempo changes, and structure changes.
You will also:
Run large-scale experiments with access to Spotify's extensive infrastructure and an audience of more than 700 million monthly active users.
Create practical applications that harness generative technologies and push the boundaries of what's possible in listening experiences.
Collaborate as part of a cross-functional team—working closely with scientists, engineers, product managers, designers, user researchers, and analysts—to craft innovative solutions to complex challenges.
Have a direct impact on Spotify's products, tools, and services, working on projects that influence the entire organization.
Engage with the broader research community by publishing your findings, delivering talks, and attending top conferences.
Who You Are
You have a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. Previous industry experience is helpful.
You have experience in one or more of the following fields: generative modeling, machine learning, music information retrieval, speech processing, audio processing, signal processing, probabilistic modeling, computer vision, or related areas.
You have deep expertise in at least one of the focus areas above—whether that's vocal/speech synthesis, post-training alignment techniques (e.g., PPO, GRPO, DPO), or audio-to-audio generation and text-guided music editing.
You have publications at leading conferences such as ICASSP, ISMIR, INTERSPEECH, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, or related venues.
You have strong coding skills in Python, PyTorch, and NumPy.
You are a creative problem solver who is passionate about building outstanding products that add real value to millions of people.
You are enthusiastic about turning research ideas into products operating at scale.
You can explain complex topics in simple terms, and you enjoy building strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
Where You'll Be
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EMEA region as long as we have a work location
This team operates within the Central European and GMT time zone for collaboration.
Core working hours are CET 3pm-6pm / EST 9am-12pm.

job.title: Senior Field Enablement Manager
job.description_text:
The Team
Our GTM Enablement team plays a critical role in helping Datadog's Sales and Customer Success teams succeed by equipping them with the right skills, knowledge, and tools at the right time. We partner closely with teams across Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Curriculum, and Operations to ensure enablement programs translate into real performance in the field.
If you like adding value and seeing the direct impact of your work, and you thrive in dynamic environments where you can roll up your sleeves and get things done, this role is for you.
The Opportunity
Datadog's Enterprise business across EMEA continues to scale, and we're looking for a Field Enablement Manager to deliver ongoing ramp and everboarding enablement for Enterprise sellers across key EMEA markets (including the UK, DACH, France, Benelux, and the Nordics) — ensuring global enablement programs land effectively amid complex, multi-country Enterprise deals.
You'll serve as a trusted partner to Enterprise Sales leaders, adapting global programs to the realities of the EMEA Enterprise motion — longer sales cycles, multi-stakeholder buying committees, and a diverse regional footprint — while staying tightly aligned with our global Field Enablement organization.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives operating independently, builds strong relationships in the field, and enjoys adapting enablement programs to meet the needs of a fast-growing, sophisticated Enterprise segment.
What You'll Do
Deliver live and virtual enablement sessions and implement training programs focused on ongoing ramp and everboarding that improve the performance and productivity of Enterprise sellers and leaders across EMEA.
Administer program certifications — score and evaluate submissions against established rubrics and provide structured feedback.
Conduct ongoing field listening (shadows, 1:1s, syncs with first-line leaders) to maintain a strong pulse on Enterprise business needs, gaps, and strengths across EMEA markets; share insights with the broader enablement team to shape programs and priorities.
Lead reinforcement and coaching to drive post-program adoption, including designing activities (role plays, deal clinics, skill practice sessions) that connect training to measurable behavior change in real, complex customer scenarios.
Partner with Curriculum, Program Management, and Operations to share field insights and pilot or co-build content, and work closely with first-line Enterprise Sales leaders to build trusted relationships, diagnose challenges, and deliver ad hoc training in response to emerging needs.
Use AI tools to accelerate delivery and reinforcement — including synthesizing field feedback and surfacing patterns — and model effective AI use for the teams you train.
Who You Are
4–5 years of experience in sales enablement, field enablement, training, or a related GTM role, with a proven delivery track record supporting Enterprise Sales and/or Customer Success teams in a SaaS or technology environment; multi-country EMEA experience is a strong plus.
Strong understanding of Datadog and/or the broader technology industry, including foundational knowledge of Datadog's core product pillars (Infrastructure, APM, Logs) and the ability to connect product capabilities to Enterprise customer value.
Strong facilitator with experience delivering engaging live and virtual training sessions to senior, sophisticated audiences, and familiarity with Enterprise sales methodologies/frameworks such as MEDDICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, Sandler, etc. (certification a plus).
Solid business acumen and comfort using performance data, field feedback, and qualitative insights to inform enablement decisions; experience with Asana or similar project management tools is a plus.
Highly collaborative and relationship-oriented — you build trust quickly with sellers, managers, and cross-functional partners.
Organized, adaptable, and comfortable operating independently across a large, diverse region.
Fluent in English, with proficiency in one or more additional European languages a plus; willing and able to travel approximately 25% across EMEA.
Why This Role Matters
As a Field Enablement Manager supporting Datadog's EMEA Enterprise business, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring our global enablement programs translate into local impact for some of our most strategic sellers and customers. You'll help accelerate ramp, build seller confidence, and enable Enterprise teams to succeed with customers across one of Datadog's fastest-growing and most complex regions.

job.title: Customer Success Manager
job.description_text:
MongoDB and Customer Success
Our Customer Success team is the linchpin of the post-sales customer relationship. By combining deep business and technical savvy, Customer Success keeps MongoDB at the center of our customers’ technology strategy, and ensures every customer can realize the full potential of their investment.
Customer Success Manager
The Role
As a Customer Success Manager, you are the trusted advisor helping customers navigate their journey on MongoDB. You’ll be responsible for maximizing customer lifetime value and success for a portfolio of accounts, acting as a strategic connector between your customers and the right resources at the right time to achieve their unique business goals. You’ll drive customer retention, revenue realization, and advocacy. You’ll build deep relationships, understand customer needs inside and out, and seamlessly navigate account team and internal resources to deliver real, measurable impact where your customers need it most.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Tokyo for our hybrid working model.
Key Responsibilities
Customer Advisory
Proactively identify risks and ensure deployment health by advising on best practices and operational strategies. Deliver optimal solutions to critical customer challenges, accelerating time-to-value and guiding customers to achieve their business goals through their MongoDB deployments.
Conduct comprehensive customer business reviews, analyzing technical health and operational performance while translating insights into value-based outcomes. Partner with technical and business leaders to align on objectives and champion mutual success plans that foster growth and retention.
Account & Portfolio Management
Own elements of the account plan that drive customer maturity and lifetime value, retention, and revenue realization. Proactively manage a portfolio of customers across various stages of the journey, creating and executing strategies to maximize value realization, advocacy, and long-term success.
Track and report progress against key business outcomes, forecast revenue retention and realization to senior leadership for business predictability, and identify new opportunities to expand customer impact, collaborating with presales teams to support growth.
Maintain meticulous hygiene in internal systems to ensure a single source of truth for customer insights and accurate territory analysis. Leverage AI-driven tools to streamline daily workflows, improve productivity, and optimize customer success outcomes.
Internal Collaboration & Customer Advocacy
Amplify the voice of the customer within MongoDB, leveraging customer insights to inform MongoDB’s product roadmap and coordinate across Sales, Product, Services, Support, and Training teams to drive customer health, satisfaction, and value realization.
Connect customers with the right internal resources, including Marketing programs and Executive Sponsor engagement, while contributing learnings from customer interactions to strengthen team success and maximize customer value.
What You Will Bring
Relevant Experience: 5 to 7+ years in a technical customer-facing role (e.g., Technical Customer Success, Solutions Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services/Implementation, Technical Account Management) for a deeply technical, ideally consumption-based, product
Accountability: 3+ years experience being accountable for customer health and revenue realization for a defined book of business for Enterprise/High Tech customers
Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills with the ability to influence technical and business outcomes
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or equivalent technical work experience
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the database for the AI era, enabling innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified database platform, the most widely available, globally distributed database on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 60,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.
MongoDBのミッションとカスタマーサクセスの役割
MongoDBのミッションは、ソフトウェアとデータの力を解き放つことで、革新者が業界を創出、変革、そして常識を覆すことです。私たちは、企業のレガシーワークロードを現代化し、イノベーションを受け入れ、AIの力を最大限に活用できるよう支援することで、あらゆる規模の組織がモダンなアプリケーションを容易に構築、拡張、運用できるようにします。
業界を牽引する当社の開発者向けデータプラットフォーム「MongoDB Atlas」は、業界唯一のグローバル分散型マルチクラウドデータベースであり、AWS、Google Cloud、Microsoft Azureにわたる115以上のリージョンで利用可能です。Atlasによって、お客様はオンプレミスや異なるクラウドプロバイダー間など、あらゆる場所でアプリケーションを構築・運用することができます。当社は世界中にオフィスを構え、毎月175,000人以上の新しい開発者が利用登録を行っており、Samsungやトヨタのような大手企業から、Delivery HeroやLG U+といったAIの革新者に至るまで、多くの企業が次世代のAI駆動型アプリケーションの構築においてMongoDBを信頼しています。
当社のカスタマーサクセスチームは、導入後のお客様との関係構築において要となる存在です。。深いビジネス知識と技術的な知見を融合させることで、カスタマーサクセスはMongoDBをお客様のテクノロジー戦略の中心に位置づける役割を担い、すべてのお客様がその投資の可能性を最大限に引き出せるよう支援しています。
募集職種：カスタマーサクセスマネジメント（The Role）
カスタマーサクセスマネジメント（CSM）の役割は、信頼されるアドバイザーとして、お客様がMongoDBを活用する上での道のりを、支援することです。
担当ポートフォリオとなる顧客アカウントの生涯価値の最大化と成功に責任を持ち、お客様固有のビジネス目標を達成するために、最適なタイミングで最適なリソースへとつなぐ戦略的パートナーとして活躍していただきます。また、顧客維持（、収益実現、およびお客様からの支持・推奨の促進
を推進する役割も担います。
お客様と深い信頼関係を築き、そのニーズを徹底的に理解した上で、アカウントチームや社内リソースをスムーズに活用し、、お客様が最も必要とする領域で目に見える確かなインパクトを提供することが求められます。
【勤務形態】 ハイブリッドワーク（東京オフィスに通勤可能な方を対象としています）
主な職務内容（Key Responsibilities）
顧客へのアドバイザリー（Customer Advisory）
プロアクティブなリスク特定と運用の最適化: ベストプラクティスや運用戦略を提案することで、プロアクティブにリスクを特定し、システムのデプロイメント・ヘルスを健全に保ちます。お客様の重大な課題に対して最適なソリューションを提供することで、価値創出までの期間（Time-to-Value）を短縮し、MongoDBの導入を通じてビジネス目標を達成できるよう導きます。
ビジネスレビューの実施と成果への変換: 包括的なビジネスレビュー（QBRなど）を実施し、技術的な健全性や運用パフォーマンスを分析した上で、そこから得られたインサイトを「価値ベースの成果」へと落とし込みます。技術リーダーやビジネスリーダーと連携して目標をすり合わせ、成長と顧客維持を促進する「相互成功計画（Mutual Success Plan）」を推進します。

進捗管理と拡大機会の創出: 重要なビジネス成果指標に対する進捗管理・レポーティングを行い、事業の予測可能性向上に向けて、収益維持および収益実現のフォーキャストを経営層へ報告していただきます。、加えて、顧客へのインパクトを拡大する新たな機会を特定し、プレセールスチームと連携してさらなる成長を支援します。
正確なデータ管理とAIツールの活用: 社内システムにおいて綿密なデータ管理（を維持し、顧客インサイトの正確な一元管理（と正確なテリトリー分析を実現します。AIツールを活用して日々のワークフローを効率化し、生産性を向上させ、カスタマーサクセスの成果を最適化します。
社内連携＆顧客の継続利用の促進（Internal Collaboration & Customer Advocacy）
顧客の声を社内へ届ける: MongoDB社内における「顧客の代弁者」として、顧客のインサイトを製品ロードマップに反映させます。また、営業、プロダクト、プロフェッショナルサービス、サポート、トレーニングなどの各チームと連携し、顧客ヘルス、満足度、および価値実現を推進します。
最適なリソースとのマッチング: マーケティングプログラムやエグゼクティブ・スポンサーとのエンゲージメントを含め、お客様を最適な社内リソースと結びつけます。同時に、顧客との対話から得られた学びをチームに共有し、チーム全体の成功を強化するとともに、顧客価値を最大化します。
求められるスキル・経験（What You Will Bring）
実務経験: 高度な技術力を要する製品（従量課金制/コンサンプションベースの製品が望ましい）において、技術系顧客対応職（テクニカルカスタマーサクセス、ソリューションアーキテクト／エンジニアリング、プロフェッショナルサービス／導入支援、テクニカルアカウントマネジメントなど）における5〜7年以上の経験。
アカウンタビリティ（責任）: エンタープライズ企業またはハイテク業界の顧客ポートフォリオを持ち、顧客のヘルスおよび収益の現実に責任を持った3年以上の経験。
コミュニケーション能力: 技術的な成果およびビジネスの成果の双方において、周囲に影響を与え、意思決定を促すことができる優れた口頭・書面でのコミュニケーションスキル。
学歴・バックグラウンド: コンピュータサイエンス、STEM（科学・技術・工学・数学）分野の学士号、またはそれと同等の技術的な実務経験。
MongoDBについて（About MongoDB）
MongoDBは「変化」に対応するために構築されており、お客様と従業員が市場のスピードに合わせてイノベーションを起こせるよう支援しています。私たちはAI時代に向けてデータベースを再定義し、革新者がソフトウェアを通じて業界を創出、変革、そして常識を覆せるようにしました。市場で最も広く利用されているグローバル分散型データベースであるMongoDBの統合データベースプラットフォームは、組織のレガシーワークロードを現代化し、イノベーションを受け入れ、AIの力を最大限に活用できるよう支援します。当社のクラウドネイティブなプラットフォームである「MongoDB Atlas」は、唯一のグローバル分散型マルチクラウドデータベースであり、AWS、Google Cloud、Microsoft Azureにわたって利用可能です。
世界中にオフィスを構え、Fortune 100の75%を占める大企業からAIネイティブのスタートアップ企業まで、60,000社以上のお客様が最も重要なアプリケーションの運用をMongoDBに託しており、私たちは次のソフトウェア時代を牽引しています。
MongoDBの指針となっているのは、私たちの「リーダーシップ・コミットメント（Leadership Commitment）」です。これは、私たちがどのように、そしてなぜ意思決定を行うのか、どのようにお互いを支え合うのか、そしてどのように勝利を収めるのかを示すガイドラインであり、これこそがMongoDBの核となる価値観です。。
従業員の個人的な成長とビジネスにおける貢献を後押しするため、私たちは誰もが支え合い、豊かになれるカルチャーの醸成に取り組んでいます。従業員のアフィニティグループ（社内コミュニティ）から、不妊治療への支援、手厚い育児休暇制度に至るまで、私たちは従業員の幸福を重視し、キャリアとプライベートのあらゆる歩みをサポートしたいと考えています。MongoDBで働く魅力をぜひ知っていただき、私たちと共に世界にインパクトを与えましょう！

job.title: Network Engineer
job.description_text:
About Nebius:
Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
The role: Network Engineer / Sr. Network Engineer
Nebius is an AI-centric purpose-built for intensive GPU using company. As our global footprint accelerates toward multiple gigawatts of capacity, we are establishing our regional network engineering presence in the Asia-Pacific region.
We are looking for a hands-on, high-autonomy Network Engineer / Senior Network Engineer to drive the build-out, connectivity, and continuous production operations of our regional data centers, PoPs, and transport fabrics across APAC, with connectivity to EU/the US region and IP transit/PNI services.
In this role, you will be the boots-on-the-ground technical authority in the region. You will bridge low-level physical bringing-up with modern CLOS fabrics, collaborating closely with our core engineering teams in the EU (Amsterdam HQ) and the US within a global follow-the-sun operational model.
This position is fully remote within the APAC region (preferred hubs: Singapore, India), with periodic domestic/regional site visits and occasional sync trips to our engineering headquarters in Amsterdam.
Your Responsibilities Will Include:
End-to-End Infrastructure Ownership: Take complete operational and deployment ownership of the network stack across APAC sites—ranging from Day-0 Out-of-Band (OOB) part of network as seed , console setups, and management L2 switches to high-scale leaf-spine frontend fabrics (EVPN/VXLAN) 400g/800g/1,6T ready and regional DCI/Backbone boundaries (BGP/MPLS/SRv6).
High-Autonomy Site Bring-up & Operations: Act independently to triage, debug, and deliver connectivity in fast-moving, greenfield colocation environments. Make sound architectural and operational calls on short notice when counter parts oversight is offline.
Global Collaboration & Follow-the-Sun Alignment: Partner tightly with core architecture, backbone, and platform teams in the EU and US. Own regional operational handoffs, participate in global on-call rotations, and conduct changes in coordinated regional maintenance windows.
Team Scaling & Knowledge Offloading: As the APAC team expands, actively onboard new engineers, write rigorous runbooks, and offload operational pipelines to incoming peers to keep the team scalable.
Dynamic Execution: Operate effectively in a high-velocity environment where quarterly business priorities, cluster locations, and deployment schedules adjust dynamically to customer demand.
We Expect You to Have:
Proven Production Routing & Switching Depth: Solid hands-on experience operating Service Provider or Scale Data Center networks. Deep working knowledge of BGP, IS-IS (or OSPF), EVPN/VXLAN, SR-MPLS/SRv6, ECMP load balancing, and L3VPN architectures.
CLOS Fabric & L2–L4 Diagnostics: Strong diagnostic instincts in multi-tier Clos fabrics. Practical mastery of TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack environments, packet analysis (tcpdump, Wireshark), interface error rates, and QoS queue behavior.
Full-Stack Network Mindset: Comfort with the entire operational pipeline: you are equally willing to console into an unconfigured management switch/OOB router at an unpolished greenfield site and tune BGP policy on multi-terabit edge borders (Juniper preferred, or relevant cisco/nokia).
Vendor Agility: Practical configuration and troubleshooting experience across modern network operating systems (Juniper Junos, Cisco IOS-XR, Arista EOS, or NVIDIA/Cumulus).
Startup Agility & Timezone Flexibility: Proven ability to self-direct, prioritize backlogs under ambiguous requirements, and maintain effective working overlap with European (CEST) and US (EST/PST) teams when critical milestones hit.
Communication: Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to document complex systems clearly and communicate concisely under Sev-1 pressure.
It Will Be an Added Bonus If You Have:
Practical scripting and network programmability skills (Python or Go, Git, NetBox, telemetry pipelines).
Practical exposure to high-performance AI networking: RoCEv2 (PFC, ECN/DCQCN, MCR) fabrics.
Experience interfacing directly with regional APAC telecom carriers, dark fiber providers, subsea consortiums, and local Internet Exchanges (e.g., Equinix IX, JPIX, SGIX).
Familiarity with Linux networking fundamentals, bridge-domains, and host-routed container networking (BGP-to-the-host).
Benefits & Perks:
Competitive compensation
Career growth and learning opportunities
Flexibility and ownership
Collaborative and innovative culture
Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
International environment and talented teams
What's it like to work at Nebius:
Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

job.title: Binance Accelerator Program - AI Agent Engineer
job.description_text:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means.
About Binance Accelerator Program
Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.
Who may apply
Current university students and recent graduates.
*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws
About the Role
We are building cutting-edge AI systems that enable the next generation of intelligent applications. Our team focuses on developing AI agents, benchmarking datasets, and robust infrastructure to support real-world deployments at scale. As part of our engineering-driven culture, you'll be exposed to a fast-paced environment where experimentation, collaboration, and innovation are encouraged.
Responsibilities
- Contribute to the design and development of AI agents integrated into live production systems
- Help build and maintain benchmark datasets to evaluate agent performance, accuracy, and safety
- Design and refine prompts, tool integrations, and agent workflows
- Implement, test, and optimize services and tooling across the stack — backend, data, scripting, automation, and glue code
- Collaborate closely with senior engineers on system design, multi-agent orchestration, and deployment
- Participate in code reviews, debugging, and documentation to ensure best practices
- Work in a team environment that encourages mentorship, knowledge sharing, and hands-on learning
Requirements
- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
- Strong programming fundamentals — language-agnostic, but practical experience with at least one of Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar
- Solid understanding of software engineering principles (data structures, algorithms, version control)
- Familiarity or working knowledge of any AI agent framework (e.g., OpenClaw, hermes-agent, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen)
- Interest in AI, data-driven systems, and building tools for real-world applications
- Good communication skills and willingness to learn quickly
What We're Looking For (Culture & Mindset)
- AI-native working style — you naturally reach for AI tools in your daily workflow, not as an afterthought but as a core part of how you think, build, and solve problems
- Eager to learn and open-minded — you stay current with the latest technologies and aren't afraid to adopt new frameworks, tools, or paradigms before they're mainstream
- First-principles thinker who's comfortable redesigning workflows rather than just optimizing existing ones
Nice to Haves
- Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or building tools on top of AI models
- Exposure to multi-agent systems or agent orchestration patterns
- Familiarity with Docker, cloud platforms, or CI/CD pipelines
- Machine learning knowledge is a plus, but not required
Why Binance
• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

job.title: Change Sales Process, Technology & AI Specialist
job.description_text:
At FIS, our technology and our people are moving forward. We advance the way the world pays, banks and invests. We believe in building inclusive, diverse teams. Together, we innovate to help our colleagues, clients and communities succeed. If you’re ready to grow your career and make an impact in fintech, we have one question: Are you FIS?
About the role:
Are you ready to own how a global commercial organization sells — the process behind it, the technology that carries it, and the AI that is about to reshape it?
FIS is looking for a Change Specialist to join the Sales Technology & AI team within our Revenue Operations, Commercial Office. This is the role that turns strategy into field behavior. You will own the design and continuous improvement of our sales process, build and personally deliver the training that makes it stick, and lead commercial AI enablement across the selling organization.
This is an individual contributor role with genuine ownership. You will not manage a team initially — you will utilize AI to influence a large, distributed and demanding one. You will design the process and write the playbook, build the learning path and run the session, define how sellers use AI, and use AI yourself to produce enablement at a pace a traditional team could not match. The ideal candidate pairs the structured thinking of a consultant with the delivery instinct of an operator and the tech fluency to utilize AI as training delivery partner — equally comfortable in a governance forum and in front of a room of skeptical sellers.
What you will be doing:
Sales Process Ownership
Own the documented end-to-end sales process — stage definitions, entry and exit criteria, qualification standards, and hand-offs across seller motions.
Maintain a single source of truth for how FIS sells through process guides, playbooks and role-based standards, refreshed on a defined cadence.
Run process governance in partnership with Revenue Operations: change intake, impact assessment, approval and controlled release to the field.
Diagnose friction in the seller workflow through field interviews and adoption data, and convert findings into a prioritized improvement roadmap.
Sales Process & Technology Training
Design, build and personally deliver the training curriculum covering sales process, methodology and the full sales technology stack.
Own the learning architecture from new-hire onboarding through tenured-seller upskilling, with distinct role-based paths for each seller persona.
Deliver across formats — live and virtual sessions, on-demand modules, micro-learning, job aids and office hours — with certification and reinforcement built in.
Act as change lead for platform rollouts and process releases, owning readiness, communications, cutover enablement and post-launch support.
Commercial AI Enablement & Governance
Own AI enablement for the commercial organization, building the fluency and practical skill that let sellers get real value from AI in their daily workflow.
Translate AI capability into role-specific, workflow-anchored use cases spanning research, call preparation, account planning, messaging and proposal support.
Build and curate the commercial prompt library and use-case catalogue, keeping both current as capability evolves.
Own commercial AI usage standards alongside Legal, Risk and Privacy, and represent the commercial organization in enterprise AI governance forums.
Impact, Adoption & Continuous Improvement
Use AI as your own production tool — generating training content and assessments, drafting communications, building role-play scenarios and analyzing feedback at scale.
Define what good looks like for process compliance, training effectiveness, technology adoption and AI usage, and make it visible to commercial leadership.
Run structured feedback loops with the field and translate them into the next iteration of process, content and training.
Report on enablement impact to Sales Technology & AI and Commercial leadership on an agreed cadence, with a clear line from activity to outcome.
What you will need:
>5 years of experience in sales enablement, sales process design, change management, revenue operations or sales training within a B2B enterprise environment.
Demonstrable experience designing and personally delivering training to a distributed sales audience — not commissioning it, delivering it.
Direct experience owning, documenting or materially reshaping a sales process in a complex organization.
Practical, hands-on use of AI in a professional context, with a clear point of view on where it genuinely helps a seller and where it does not.
Strong change management capability — able to plan, sequence and land change across a large, distributed and often skeptical audience.
Ability to operate independently as an individual contributor, influencing senior stakeholders without formal authority, across NA, EMEA and APAC time zones.
What you should have:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Marketing or a related field
Background in financial services, fintech or enterprise SaaS.
Experience working in Global MNC Organizations.
Familiarity with a modern sales technology stack — CRM, sales engagement, content enablement, conversation intelligence and data intelligence platforms.
Exposure to a major CRM or platform migration as an enablement, training or change owner.
Working knowledge of a recognized sales methodology, and a formal change management credential such as Prosci/ADKAR — a plus.
What we offer you:
At FIS, we are as committed to growing our employees’ careers as our own business. We offer:
Opportunities to innovate in fintech
Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere
Professional and personal development
Resources to contribute to your community
Competitive salary and benefits
Privacy Statement
FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.
Sourcing Model
Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

job.title: Liquidity Operations Analyst
job.description_text:
Work with the best
We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi.
At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold –concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space.
Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past.
We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all.
A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network
What will you be working on?
Process, clean, and validate liquidity and trading data to ensure accuracy and usability.
Extract and transform trading data to generate regular reports (weekly/monthly) and support alerting mechanisms.
Monitor liquidity dashboards and identify anomalies in a timely manner.
Maintain and update market parameter configuration tables.
Support market maker onboarding and assist with incentive distribution processes.
Participate in data analysis for liquidity mechanism design and assist in testing new incentive models.
Who will you be working with?
Work closely with the liquidity operations team on daily monitoring and execution.
Collaborate with product, trading, and data teams to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency.
Support coordination with market makers during onboarding and ongoing operations.
What challenges will you face?
Handling large volumes of trading data with high accuracy requirements.
Identifying anomalies and ensuring data quality in a fast-moving trading environment.
Balancing data processing, monitoring, and operational support tasks simultaneously.
Adapting quickly to evolving liquidity strategies and incentive mechanisms.
Interested in Learning More?
Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues.
If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus.

job.description_text:
Our ambition is to set a standard of excellence when it comes to serving the open source ecosystem. This is your chance to be a part of that as a Community Engineer at Canonical.
We are building community management at scale. We have multiple positions available, at different seniority levels.
All applications and candidates are handled through this single entry point.
To improve your chances of success in this application, read our advice on how to get a job at Canonical.
The role of a Community Engineer
The Community team at Canonical enables community leaders and participants to get things done, co-ordinating with Canonical teams and ensuring that community processes are efficient and well run. We don't do the work of the community, but we facilitate that work to ensure that energetic and ambitious community members with their own vision of open source can benefit from the work Canonical does and bring their own flavor of Ubuntu into being, to meet the needs and express the interests of their community. You will play a key role in designing, executing, and scaling initiatives that foster a thriving community.
This is an exciting opportunity for a technically proficient person who is passionate about open source software, Linux, and sustainable community building.
In this role, you will support community initiatives with your technical skills and strong organizational skills. You work hand in hand with developers to smooth processes and integrate community plans with Canonical plans for maximum impact. You can encourage and facilitate the creation of new technical projects that enhance the community contribution experience, and you represent community interests to Canonical teams. You will lead complex, multi-disciplinary programs from conception through launch, working closely with Developer Relations engineers, technical authors, product managers, marketing teams, engineering teams, and external partners.
You will support and engage with volunteer developers in the Ubuntu community, addressing their concerns and helping them to create successful tools. You will help to ensure their success and the overall autonomy and sustainability of projects.
You will provide the content and technical support to ensure the community stays engaged and informed. This will include regular blog and social media posts about community initiatives, events, accomplishments, and collaborative efforts between Canonical and the Ubuntu community.
You will communicate effectively with developers and software engineers and represent not only the Ubuntu community but Canonical as a contributor to the wider Linux ecosystem. Our team attends conferences and expos, and talks about technical community projects and their development processes.
Location: These are fully remote roles, open to candidates across the globe.
What your day will look like
Write high quality content to promote and support community initiatives
Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions to community problems
Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
Potential opportunity to travel more if you wish
Nurture community contributions to Ubuntu
Engage with the Ubuntu community through Discourse, Matrix, social media, conferences, etc.
Represent Ubuntu via speaking engagements at events and conferences
Support the engagement by Canonical teams into the open source ecosystem
What we are looking for in you
You love technology and working with brilliant people
You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
You have experience with developer tools and open source projects
You have a clear public record of accomplishments (talks, blog posts, GitHub, X, etc.)
You have interest and experience with some of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, DevOps, software development, testing and QA, package management, container technology
You can work autonomously and assume full ownership of objectives as needed
You can be flexible with your time and enjoy working with new technology in a fast-paced environment
You are experienced working with open source communities and understand the workflow of volunteer contributors
You have experience in (technical) program management and have excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills
Additional skills that you might also bring
Experience with community management
Experience with Developer advocacy
Experience as a software developer
Examples of contributions to the Ubuntu Community
Experience with contributing to open source projects
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Employee Assistance Program
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

job.title: Data Scientist
job.description_text:
Job Summary:We are seeking a talented Data Scientist to join our remote team. As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing machine learning models, and deriving actionable insights to drive business decisions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in statistics, machine learning, and programming, along with the ability to work independently in a remote environment. This is an exciting opportunity to apply your skills to real-world problems and contribute to innovative projects from anywhere in the world.
Responsibilities:
Analyze large datasets to extract meaningful patterns, trends, and insights using statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms.
Develop predictive models and algorithms to solve business problems and optimize decision-making processes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project objectives, gather requirements, and prioritize tasks.
Clean, preprocess, and manipulate data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency for analysis.
Build and deploy machine learning models into production environments, and monitor their performance over time.
Interpret and communicate analysis results and insights to stakeholders through visualizations, reports, and presentations.
Stay updated with the latest developments in data science, machine learning, and AI technologies, and apply them to improve existing models and methodologies.
Conduct experiments and A/B tests to evaluate model performance and validate hypotheses.
Mentor junior data scientists and provide guidance on best practices in data analysis and modeling.
Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; Master's or Ph.D. degree is a plus.
Minimum of 3 years of experience in data science, machine learning, or related fields.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, along with experience with data manipulation and analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn).
Strong understanding of statistical concepts and methods, and experience with hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and time series forecasting.
Hands-on experience with machine learning techniques such as classification, regression, clustering, and natural language processing.
Familiarity with data visualization tools and techniques (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau).
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, and proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work independently and as part of a remote team.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

job.description_text:
Who We Are:
Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.
Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.
Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.
Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.
Our Team Members:
We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!
We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.
NOTE: PLEASE DO NOT APPLY UNLESS YOU'RE JLPT N1 (FLUENT JAPANESE)
Your Role:
As a Senior Engineer, we want you to be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the systems and services that form Alpaca's foundation and empower millions of users who trade billions of dollars worth of assets. We will look to you to contribute to regional recruitment initiatives, help drive cross-functional team projects, mentor teammates with respect to our engineering principles and practices, and foster Alpaca culture in the Japan region. We expect you to participate in operational reliability engineering during regional business hours, helping to ensure proactive 24x7 stability of our platform.
For this role, we are seeking an experienced backend engineer who is dedicated to delivering seamless and high-quality software solutions. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of designing and building scalable applications, is comfortable challenging conventions and advocating for innovative solutions, and can bridge engineering work with Japan-specific regulatory, vendor, and partner requirements. In this position, we would like you to have the autonomy to architect and implement solutions that meet our strategic objectives while also actively contributing to the goal-setting process alongside a collaborative, cross-functional team.
Things You Get To Do:
Design highly scalable, mission-critical brokerage systems for the Japan market.
Develop and enhance the middle- and back-office systems, including gRPC microservices, REST and gRPC APIs, and third-party vendor integrations specific to the Japan market (e.g. JPX, JSCC, JASDEC, banks, identity verification vendors).
Work closely with Alpaca's core teams to enhance and transform the core framework, enabling support for multiple languages, currencies, and markets, with a particular focus on Japan-specific requirements such as NISA, MyNumber, withholding tax, and JP-GAAP accounting.
Collaborate with tech leads in other regions both synchronously and asynchronously, primarily through Slack and meetings, to align with global teams.
Coordinate in Japanese with local regulators, vendors, partners, and business stakeholders, and translate those requirements into technical specifications for the global engineering team.
Troubleshoot incidents and reported bugs to maintain system integrity and performance.
Participate in on-call rotations and assist with timely engineering projects and production issues during Japan business hours.
Thrive in a global environment, effectively navigating regulatory requirements and building scalable solutions to support Alpaca's expansion in Japan.
Who You Are (Must-Haves):
Native or JLPT N1 level fluency in Japanese, with the ability to read, write, and communicate professionally with local regulators, vendors, and partners.
Business-level English fluency, with the ability to collaborate effectively in English-only team meetings, design discussions, code reviews, and written documentation.
Proven experience in designing and developing complex financial systems, preferably including double-entry accounting.
Strong understanding of accounting principles, ledger structures, and transaction reconciliation.
Experience in building scalable, high-availability financial applications that handle multi-currency transactions.
Familiarity with regulatory compliance requirements in financial markets, with a preference for experience in Japan (FIEA, FSA, JSDA, JIPF, or related frameworks).
Proficiency in at least one statically typed language (e.g. Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C#, Scala, or C++), with expertise in designing robust and efficient system architectures.
Experience working with financial APIs, market data integrations, and trade settlement processes.
Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with global teams, local regulators, vendors, and internal stakeholders, bridging Japanese and English contexts.
Strong computer science fundamentals and proven software engineering architecture experience.
Ability to work independently in a fully remote, globally distributed team, and under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
Strategic thinking and the ability to translate technical concepts into business strategies.
Experience with domain-driven design and event-driven design.
Strong problem-solving skills paired with a proactive mindset.
Ability to lead and troubleshoot incidents or bugs with authority during Japan business hours.
Who You Might Be (Nice-To-Haves):
Proficiency in Go, or willingness to ramp up quickly — Go is Alpaca's primary backend language.
Experience in the Japanese financial services sector (securities firms, banks, brokerages, or fintech).
Hands-on experience integrating with Japan market infrastructure such as JPX (TSE/OSE), JSCC, JASDEC, or major Japanese banks.
Experience with Japan-specific products such as NISA, iDeCo, tokutei-koza, or MyNumber handling.
Experience working in a startup or fast-growing technology company.
Knowledge of emerging technologies.
Experience or passion for financial markets.
Experience managing vendors and organizational budgeting.
Experience working with global, English-speaking teams across multiple time zones.
How We Take Care of You:
Competitive Salary & Stock Options
Health Benefits
New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

job.description_text:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Neobank app.
This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.
What You'll Own
Build backend services and APIs for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX, KYC and risk flows.
Design reliable systems that can support real customer transactions, operational workflows and future financial products.
Integrate with internal systems, financial partners, payment providers, AI services and third-party platforms.
Own backend quality across reliability, security, latency, observability, data integrity and incident handling.
Work with product, frontend, mobile and AI teams to launch features quickly and safely.
Improve existing systems by simplifying flows, removing manual work and automating repeatable processes.

Strong backend engineering experience in production systems.
Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations.
Experience building services used by real customers or internal operations at meaningful scale.
Strong debugging, reliability, security and data quality mindset.
Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, correctness, scalability and maintainability.
Fintech, payments, banking, wallet, KYC, fraud or risk experience is a strong plus, but not required if fundamentals are strong.
This Role Is Not For
Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.
People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.
Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.
Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.
People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership.

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Thailand. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Thailand.

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Technical interview
3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

job.title: Containerization & Virtualisation Engineer
job.description_text:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology - from the kernel through userspace. Apply here if you are an exceptional Go, Rust, or C/C++ software engineer and want to work on next-generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage.
Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure have become essentials of modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro service architecture or cloud infrastructure.
Here are some examples of projects under way at Canonical.
RustVMM has great potential as a new hypervisor for Linux. We are building a team to work on this, with an emphasis on performance, security and operability. Work in Rust and bring your expert knowledge of VMM and related kernel networking and storage capabilities.
Docker images are easy to make and publish on Docker Hub and other registries, but the quality, consistency and security maintenance of those images is broadly very poor. Canonical is in a good position to publish a portfolio of outstanding Docker images. Our Rockcraft team is designing and implementing an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.
LXD is a modern system container and virtual machine manager that is widely used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms. LXD engineering spans the entire software stack from low-level kernel work on namespaces, confinement, security, filesystems, VMMs and networking, to the high level management REST API and CLI.
Members of the Kubernetes product team build MicroK8s for on-rails K8s, and Charmed Kubernetes for more sophisticated integration. We work on K8s itself and on the operations tooling around it.
The OpenStack team deliver Charmed OpenStack, OVN / OVS and Ceph. This work brings cloud platform technologies to large-scale computing environments.
These teams hire system level C/C++, Golang, Rust and Python developers to work on security-critical, performance-critical and mission-critical code, focused on software delivery, containers, security, sandboxing, application orchestration and management. Our teams are motivated to have a meaningful impact on modern cloud computing technologies.

Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
